verse_text_en: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and grown fat; then will they turn to other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.

verse_text_en: Behold, a prophet came near to Ahab king of Israel, and said, "Thus says Yahweh, 'Have you seen all this great multitude? Behold, I will deliver it into your hand this day; and you shall know that I am Yahweh.'"

Mientras tanto, un profeta se presentó ante Acab, rey de Israel, y le anunció:

Él librará aun al que no es inocente;

promise_type_description: God rescues His people from bondage, danger or judgment.
why_promise: God promises to deliver the innocent through the purity of their actions.

verse_text_en: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I shall come forth like gold.
verse_text_es:
Él, en cambio, conoce mis caminos;
si me pusiera a prueba, saldría yo puro como el oro.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's sovereignty and protection are assured, even in the midst of trial.

verse_text_en: I will teach you about the hand of God. That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
verse_text_es:
»¡Yo les voy a mostrar algo del poder de Dios!
¡No les voy a ocultar los planes del Todopoderoso!
verse_text_bilingual:
I will teach you about the hand of God. That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

»¡Yo les voy a mostrar algo del poder de Dios!
¡No les voy a ocultar los planes del Todopoderoso!
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to teach Job about His hand, implying protection and guidance.

verse_text_en: Behold, my terror shall not make you afraid, neither shall my pressure be heavy on you.
verse_text_es:
No debieras alarmarte ni temerme,
ni debiera pesar mi mano sobre ti.
verse_text_bilingual:
Behold, my terror shall not make you afraid, neither shall my pressure be heavy on you.

No debieras alarmarte ni temerme,
ni debiera pesar mi mano sobre ti.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God assures Job that his terror and pressure will not be overwhelming.

verse_text_en: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life shall see the light.'
verse_text_es:
Dios me libró de caer en la tumba;
¡estoy vivo y disfruto de la luz!”.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's redemption is a promise of safety and rescue from harm.

verse_text_en: For the work of a man he will render to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
verse_text_es:
Dios paga al hombre según sus obras;
lo trata como se merece.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises to render to each person according to their ways, indicating a sense of justice and accountability.

verse_text_en: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.
verse_text_es:
¡Ni pensar que Dios actúe con maldad!
¡El Todopoderoso no pervierte la justicia!
verse_text_bilingual:
Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

¡Ni pensar que Dios actúe con maldad!
¡El Todopoderoso no pervierte la justicia!
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's character is described as not doing evil and upholding justice.

verse_text_en: Teach me that which I don't see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more'?
verse_text_es:
Enséñame lo que no alcanzo a percibir;
si he cometido algo malo, no volveré a hacerlo”.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: Job asks God to teach him, implying a request for guidance, and promises to change his behavior if he has erred.
condition_clause: If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more'

verse_text_en: I will answer you, and your companions with you.
verse_text_es:
»Pues bien, voy a responderles
a ti y a tus amigos.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will answer you, and your companions with you.

»Pues bien, voy a responderles
a ti y a tus amigos.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God promises to answer and guide Job and his companions.

verse_text_en: If they listen and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
verse_text_bilingual:
If they listen and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

Si ellos obedecen y le sirven,
pasan el resto de su vida en prosperidad;
pasan felices los años que les quedan.
promise_type_description: A divine commitment that does not fit the other categories.
why_promise: God promises prosperity to those who serve him.
condition_clause: If they listen and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures

verse_text_en: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?
verse_text_es:
¿Puedes confiar en él para que acarree tu grano
y lo junte en el lugar donde lo limpias?
verse_text_bilingual:
Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?

¿Puedes confiar en él para que acarree tu grano
y lo junte en el lugar donde lo limpias?
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God asks Job if he trusts him to provide for his needs.

verse_text_en: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.
verse_text_es:
Yo, por mi parte, reconoceré
que en tu mano derecha está la salvación.
verse_text_bilingual:
Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

Yo, por mi parte, reconoceré
que en tu mano derecha está la salvación.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God commits to admit Job's right hand can save him, implying a promise of protection.

verse_text_en: Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has."
verse_text_es: Tomen ahora siete novillos y siete carneros, vayan con mi siervo Job y ofrezcan un holocausto por ustedes mismos. Mi siervo Job orará por ustedes, y yo atenderé a su oración y no los haré quedar en vergüenza. Conste que, a diferencia de mi siervo Job, lo que ustedes han dicho de mí no es verdad».
verse_text_bilingual:
Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has."

Tomen ahora siete novillos y siete carneros, vayan con mi siervo Job y ofrezcan un holocausto por ustedes mismos. Mi siervo Job orará por ustedes, y yo atenderé a su oración y no los haré quedar en vergüenza. Conste que, a diferencia de mi siervo Job, lo que ustedes han dicho de mí no es verdad».
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God commands Job to pray for others, showing his acceptance and willingness to bless those who honor him.

verse_text_en: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that brings forth its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
verse_text_es:
Es como el árbol plantado a la orilla de un río
que, cuando llega su tiempo, da fruto
y sus hojas jamás se marchitan.
Todo cuanto hace prospera.
verse_text_bilingual:
He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that brings forth its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

Es como el árbol plantado a la orilla de un río
que, cuando llega su tiempo, da fruto
y sus hojas jamás se marchitan.
Todo cuanto hace prospera.
promise_type_description: A divine commitment that does not fit the other categories.
why_promise: This is a promise made by God about the blessings of those who follow God's ways.

verse_text_en: I will tell of the decree. Yahweh said to me, "You are my son. Today I have become your father.
verse_text_es:
Yo proclamaré el decreto del Señor:
«Tú eres mi hijo», me ha dicho,
«hoy mismo te he engendrado.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will tell of the decree. Yahweh said to me, "You are my son. Today I have become your father.

Yo proclamaré el decreto del Señor:
«Tú eres mi hijo», me ha dicho,
«hoy mismo te he engendrado.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God establishes a father-son relationship with David, committing to be his father.

verse_text_en: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.
verse_text_bilingual:
Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

Pídeme,
y como herencia te entregaré las naciones;
serán tu propiedad los confines de la tierra.
promise_type_description: A divine commitment that does not fit the other categories.
why_promise: God commits to give the nations to David as an inheritance.

verse_text_en: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
verse_text_es:
No me asustan los miles de escuadrones
que me acosan por doquier.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

No me asustan los miles de escuadrones
que me acosan por doquier.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise of protection and deliverance from enemies.

verse_text_en: But know that Yahweh has set apart for himself him who is godly: Yahweh will hear when I call to him.
verse_text_es:
Sepan que el Señor honra al que le es fiel;
el Señor me escucha cuando lo llamo.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to hear the righteous in prayer.

verse_text_en: Many say, "Who will show us any good?" Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.
verse_text_es:
Muchos son los que dicen:
«¿Quién puede mostrarnos algún bien?».
¡Haz, Señor, que sobre nosotros
brille la luz de tu rostro!
verse_text_bilingual:
Many say, "Who will show us any good?" Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.

Muchos son los que dicen:
«¿Quién puede mostrarnos algún bien?».
¡Haz, Señor, que sobre nosotros
brille la luz de tu rostro!
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's presence and light are requested as a means of protection and comfort.

verse_text_en: Yahweh, in the morning you shall hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
verse_text_bilingual:
Yahweh, in the morning you shall hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

Por la mañana, Señor, escuchas mi clamor;
por la mañana te presento mis ruegos
y quedo a la espera de tu respuesta.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to hear and respond to the psalmist's prayers in the morning.

verse_text_en: For you will bless the righteous. Yahweh, you will surround him with favor as with a shield. For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, upon the eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm by David.
verse_text_es:
Porque tú, Señor, bendices al justo;
cual escudo lo rodeas con tu buena voluntad.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God promises to bless the righteous and surround them with favor.

verse_text_en: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
verse_text_es:
Juzgará al mundo con justicia;
gobernará a los pueblos con equidad.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to judge the world in righteousness and administer justice.

verse_text_en: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.
verse_text_es:
El Señor es refugio de los oprimidos;
es su baluarte en momentos de angustia.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to be a refuge and protection for the oppressed.

verse_text_en: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.
verse_text_es:
En ti confían los que conocen tu nombre,
porque tú, Señor, jamás abandonas a los que te buscan.
verse_text_bilingual:
Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.

En ti confían los que conocen tu nombre,
porque tú, Señor, jamás abandonas a los que te buscan.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God assures those who seek him that he has not forsaken them.

verse_text_en: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
verse_text_es:
Los malvados bajan a los dominios de la muerte,
bajan todas la naciones que de Dios se olvidan.
verse_text_bilingual:
The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.

Los malvados bajan a los dominios de la muerte,
bajan todas la naciones que de Dios se olvidan.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise of judgment and protection for those who remember and fear him.

verse_text_en: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
verse_text_es:
Pero el necesitado no será olvidado para siempre
ni para siempre se perderá la esperanza del pobre.
verse_text_bilingual:
For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

Pero el necesitado no será olvidado para siempre
ni para siempre se perderá la esperanza del pobre.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to care for the needy and preserve their hope.

verse_text_en: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
verse_text_es:
Tú, Señor, escuchas el deseo de los indefensos,
les infundes aliento y atiendes a su clamor.
verse_text_bilingual:
Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,

Tú, Señor, escuchas el deseo de los indefensos,
les infundes aliento y atiendes a su clamor.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God promises to hear the desires of the humble and prepare their heart.

verse_text_en: "Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise," says Yahweh; "I will set him in safety from those who malign him."
verse_text_es:
«Por la aflicción de los oprimidos
y por el gemido del pobre,
voy a levantarme», dice el Señor,
«y los pondré a salvo de quienes los oprimen».
verse_text_bilingual:
"Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise," says Yahweh; "I will set him in safety from those who malign him."

«Por la aflicción de los oprimidos
y por el gemido del pobre,
voy a levantarme», dice el Señor,
«y los pondré a salvo de quienes los oprimen».
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God commits to protect the oppressed and vulnerable.

verse_text_en: You will keep them, Yahweh. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
verse_text_es:
Tú, Señor, los protegerás;
tú siempre los defenderás de esta gente.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to preserve and keep his people from future generations.

verse_text_en: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When Yahweh restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad. A Psalm by David.
verse_text_es:
¡Oh, si de Sión saliera la salvación de Israel!
Cuando el Señor restaure a su pueblo,
¡Jacob se regocijará, Israel se alegrará!
verse_text_bilingual:
Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When Yahweh restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad. A Psalm by David.

¡Oh, si de Sión saliera la salvación de Israel!
Cuando el Señor restaure a su pueblo,
¡Jacob se regocijará, Israel se alegrará!
promise_type_description: God saves His people from sin and gives eternal life.
why_promise: God's restoration of his people is a promise of salvation for Israel.

verse_text_en: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
verse_text_es:
No me abandonarás en los dominios de la muerte;
no permitirás que sufra corrupción tu siervo fiel.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to preserve his people's souls and keep them from harm.

verse_text_en: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forevermore. A Prayer by David.
verse_text_bilingual:
You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forevermore. A Prayer by David.

Me has dado a conocer el camino de la vida;
me llenarás de alegría en tu presencia
y de dicha eterna a tu derecha.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God promises to show David the path of life.

verse_text_en: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.
verse_text_es:
Dios mío, a ti clamo porque tú me respondes;
inclina a mí tu oído y escucha mi oración.
promise_type_description: God hears and answers the prayer of His people.
why_promise: God commits to answer the psalmist's prayer, which is a promise of answered prayer.

verse_text_en: For you will save the afflicted people, but the haughty eyes you will bring down.
verse_text_es:
Tú das la victoria a los humildes,
pero humillas a los altivos.
verse_text_bilingual:
For you will save the afflicted people, but the haughty eyes you will bring down.

Tú das la victoria a los humildes,
pero humillas a los altivos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to save the afflicted people.

verse_text_en: For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.
verse_text_es:
Tú, Señor, mantienes mi lámpara encendida;
tú, Dios mío, iluminas mis tinieblas.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to light up the darkness, indicating protection and guidance.

verse_text_en: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.
verse_text_es:
Los aplasté. Ya no pudieron levantarse.
¡Cayeron debajo de mis pies!
verse_text_bilingual:
I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.

Los aplasté. Ya no pudieron levantarse.
¡Cayeron debajo de mis pies!
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect and defeat his enemies.

verse_text_en: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's deliverance and exaltation of David as a leader of nations.

verse_text_en: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.
verse_text_es:
Apenas me oyen, me obedecen;
son extranjeros y me rinden homenaje.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God promises that people will obey him when they hear of him.

verse_text_en: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May Yahweh grant all your requests.
verse_text_es:
Nosotros celebraremos tu victoria
y en el nombre de nuestro Dios desplegaremos las banderas.
Que el Señor cumpla todas tus peticiones.
verse_text_bilingual:
We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May Yahweh grant all your requests.

Nosotros celebraremos tu victoria
y en el nombre de nuestro Dios desplegaremos las banderas.
Que el Señor cumpla todas tus peticiones.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God's promise to grant the Israelites' requests, expressed in covenant language.

verse_text_en: Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.
verse_text_es:
Ahora sé que el Señor
salvará a su ungido,
que le responderá desde su santo cielo
y con su poder le dará grandes victorias.
verse_text_bilingual:
Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.

Ahora sé que el Señor
salvará a su ungido,
que le responderá desde su santo cielo
y con su poder le dará grandes victorias.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's commitment to protect and save his anointed one.

verse_text_en: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
verse_text_es:
Tu mano alcanzará a todos tus enemigos;
tu diestra alcanzará a los que te aborrecen.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect and deliver his people from their enemies.

verse_text_en: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.
verse_text_es:
Porque tú los harás retroceder
cuando tenses tu arco contra ellos.
verse_text_bilingual:
For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.

Porque tú los harás retroceder
cuando tenses tu arco contra ellos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect his people from their enemies.

verse_text_en: I will declare your name to my brothers. In the midst of the assembly, I will praise you.
verse_text_es:
Proclamaré tu nombre a mis hermanos;
en medio de la congregación te alabaré.
promise_type_description: A divine commitment that does not fit the other categories.
why_promise: This is a declaration of God's name by David, expressing his praise and recognition of God's greatness.

verse_text_en: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise Yahweh who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises to provide for the humble and give them eternal life.

verse_text_en: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
verse_text_es:
Se acordarán del Señor y se volverán a él
todos los confines de la tierra;
ante él se postrarán
todas las familias de las naciones,
verse_text_bilingual:
All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.

Se acordarán del Señor y se volverán a él
todos los confines de la tierra;
ante él se postrarán
todas las familias de las naciones,
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's people will be remembered and worshiped by all nations.

verse_text_en: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can't keep his soul alive.
verse_text_bilingual:
All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can't keep his soul alive.

Festejarán y adorarán todos los ricos de la tierra;
ante él se postrarán todos los que bajan al polvo,
los que no pueden conservar su vida.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's sovereignty and power over all nations and individuals.

verse_text_en: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
verse_text_es:
La posteridad le servirá;
del Señor se hablará a las generaciones futuras.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God's promise to Abraham (Genesis 22:18) and his descendants, indicating a future people who will serve Him.

verse_text_en: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it. A Psalm by David.
verse_text_es:
A un pueblo que aún no ha nacido
se le dirá que Dios hizo justicia.
verse_text_bilingual:
They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it. A Psalm by David.

A un pueblo que aún no ha nacido
se le dirá que Dios hizo justicia.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's righteousness will be declared to future generations, indicating a promise of God's guidance and revelation.

verse_text_en: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.
verse_text_es: El Señor es mi pastor, nada me falta;
verse_text_bilingual:
Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.

El Señor es mi pastor, nada me falta;
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's care and provision for his people, expressed as a shepherd's care for his flock.

verse_text_en: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
verse_text_es:
Aun si voy
por valles tenebrosos,
no temeré ningún mal
porque tú estás a mi lado;
tu vara y tu bastón me reconfortan.
verse_text_bilingual:
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

Aun si voy
por valles tenebrosos,
no temeré ningún mal
porque tú estás a mi lado;
tu vara y tu bastón me reconfortan.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's presence and comfort are a promise of protection and care.

verse_text_en: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh's house forever. A Psalm by David.
verse_text_es:
Seguro estoy de que la bondad y el amor
me seguirán todos los días de mi vida;
y en la casa del Señor
habitaré para siempre.
verse_text_bilingual:
Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh's house forever. A Psalm by David.

Seguro estoy de que la bondad y el amor
me seguirán todos los días de mi vida;
y en la casa del Señor
habitaré para siempre.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's goodness and loving kindness are a promise of his presence and care for David.

verse_text_en: He shall receive a blessing from Yahweh, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verse_text_es:
Quien es así recibe bendiciones del Señor;
el Dios de su salvación le hará justicia.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God promises a blessing to those who trust in him.

verse_text_en: Yes, no one who waits for you shall be shamed. They shall be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
verse_text_es:
Quien en ti pone su esperanza
jamás será avergonzado;
pero quedarán en vergüenza
los que traicionan sin razón.
verse_text_bilingual:
Yes, no one who waits for you shall be shamed. They shall be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.

Quien en ti pone su esperanza
jamás será avergonzado;
pero quedarán en vergüenza
los que traicionan sin razón.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect those who wait on him and to judge those who act treacherously.

verse_text_en: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
verse_text_es:
Bueno y justo es el Señor;
por eso les muestra a los pecadores el camino.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's character and actions assure that he will guide sinners.

verse_text_en: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
verse_text_es:
Él dirige en la justicia a los humildes,
y les enseña su camino.
verse_text_bilingual:
He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

Él dirige en la justicia a los humildes,
y les enseña su camino.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God promises to guide the humble in justice.

verse_text_en: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verse_text_es:
Todas las sendas del Señor son amor y verdad
para quienes cumplen los mandatos de su pacto.
verse_text_bilingual:
All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

Todas las sendas del Señor son amor y verdad
para quienes cumplen los mandatos de su pacto.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to guide those who keep his covenant and testimonies.

verse_text_en: What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
verse_text_es:
¿Quién es el hombre que teme al Señor?
Será instruido en el mejor de los caminos.
verse_text_bilingual:
What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.

¿Quién es el hombre que teme al Señor?
Será instruido en el mejor de los caminos.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God promises to guide those who fear him.

verse_text_en: His soul shall dwell at ease. His seed shall inherit the land.
verse_text_es:
Tendrá una vida próspera
y sus descendientes heredarán la tierra.
verse_text_bilingual:
His soul shall dwell at ease. His seed shall inherit the land.

Tendrá una vida próspera
y sus descendientes heredarán la tierra.
promise_type_description: A divine commitment that does not fit the other categories.
why_promise: God's promise of comfort and provision for future generations.

verse_text_en: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
verse_text_es:
El Señor brinda su amistad a quienes le temen
y les da a conocer su pacto.
verse_text_bilingual:
The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.

El Señor brinda su amistad a quienes le temen
y les da a conocer su pacto.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to show his covenant to those who fear him.

verse_text_en: My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
verse_text_es:
Mis ojos están puestos siempre en el Señor,
pues solo él puede sacarme de la trampa.
verse_text_bilingual:
My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.

Mis ojos están puestos siempre en el Señor,
pues solo él puede sacarme de la trampa.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect and deliver the psalmist from evil.

verse_text_en: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God is described as the source of comfort and strength, promising to protect and care for the psalmist.

verse_text_en: For in the day of trouble he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the covert of his tabernacle he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.
verse_text_es:
Porque en el día de la aflicción
él me resguardará en su morada;
al amparo de su santuario me protegerá
y me pondrá en alto sobre una roca.
verse_text_bilingual:
For in the day of trouble he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the covert of his tabernacle he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

Porque en el día de la aflicción
él me resguardará en su morada;
al amparo de su santuario me protegerá
y me pondrá en alto sobre una roca.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to keep and protect David in times of trouble.

verse_text_en: When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahweh will take me up.
verse_text_es:
Aunque mi padre y mi madre me abandonen,
el Señor me acogerá.
verse_text_bilingual:
When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahweh will take me up.

Aunque mi padre y mi madre me abandonen,
el Señor me acogerá.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect and care for the psalmist even when his parents forsake him.

verse_text_en: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.
verse_text_es:
Pero de una cosa estoy seguro:
he de ver la bondad del Señor
en esta tierra de los vivientes.
verse_text_bilingual:
I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.

Pero de una cosa estoy seguro:
he de ver la bondad del Señor
en esta tierra de los vivientes.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's goodness is a promise of protection and care for the psalmist.

verse_text_en: Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace. A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David.
verse_text_es:
El Señor fortalece a su pueblo;
el Señor bendice a su pueblo con la paz.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God commits to give strength and bless his people with peace.

verse_text_en: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.
verse_text_es:
Al amparo de tu presencia los proteges
de las intrigas humanas;
en tu morada los resguardas
de las lenguas contenciosas.
verse_text_bilingual:
In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

Al amparo de tu presencia los proteges
de las intrigas humanas;
en tu morada los resguardas
de las lenguas contenciosas.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect and hide his people from evil.

verse_text_en: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.
verse_text_es:
Que te invoquen todos los fieles
en momentos que puedas ser hallado;
caudalosas aguas podrán desbordarse,
pero no los alcanzarán.
verse_text_bilingual:
For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

Que te invoquen todos los fieles
en momentos que puedas ser hallado;
caudalosas aguas podrán desbordarse,
pero no los alcanzarán.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's protection is described as a shield that will not be breached by the great waters.

verse_text_en: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verse_text_bilingual:
You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

Tú eres mi refugio;
tú me protegerás del peligro
y me rodearás con cánticos de liberación.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's presence and protection are described as a promise to David.

verse_text_en: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
verse_text_es:
El Señor dice:
«Yo te instruiré,
yo te mostraré el camino que debes seguir;
yo te daré consejos y velaré por ti.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

El Señor dice:
«Yo te instruiré,
yo te mostraré el camino que debes seguir;
yo te daré consejos y velaré por ti.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God promises to guide and counsel the psalmist.

verse_text_en: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.
verse_text_es:
Muchos son los sufrimientos de los malvados,
pero el gran amor del Señor
envuelve a los que en él confían.
verse_text_bilingual:
Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.

Muchos son los sufrimientos de los malvados,
pero el gran amor del Señor
envuelve a los que en él confían.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: The verse expresses a commitment by God to surround the righteous with loving kindness, protecting them from many sorrows.

verse_text_en: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
verse_text_es:
Los leoncillos se debilitan y tienen hambre,
pero a los que buscan al Señor nada les falta.
verse_text_bilingual:
The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.

Los leoncillos se debilitan y tienen hambre,
pero a los que buscan al Señor nada les falta.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to provide for those who seek Him.

verse_text_en: Yahweh redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned. By David.
verse_text_es:
El Señor libra a sus siervos;
no serán condenados los que en él se refugian.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise of redemption and protection for those who take refuge in him.

verse_text_en: All my bones shall say, "Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?"
verse_text_es:
Así todo mi ser exclamará:
«¿Quién como tú, Señor?
Tú libras de los poderosos a los pobres;
a los pobres y necesitados libras
de aquellos que los explotan».
verse_text_bilingual:
All my bones shall say, "Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?"

Así todo mi ser exclamará:
«¿Quién como tú, Señor?
Tú libras de los poderosos a los pobres;
a los pobres y necesitados libras
de aquellos que los explotan».
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's deliverance is described as a promise to protect the poor and needy.

verse_text_en: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.
verse_text_es:
¿Hasta cuándo, Señor, vas a tolerar esto?
Libra mi vida, mi única vida,
de los ataques de esos leones.
verse_text_bilingual:
Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.

¿Hasta cuándo, Señor, vas a tolerar esto?
Libra mi vida, mi única vida,
de los ataques de esos leones.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to rescue and protect the psalmist from harm.

verse_text_en: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
verse_text_es:
Se sacian de la abundancia de tu casa;
les das a beber en el río de tus delicias.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises to provide for his people's needs and satisfy them with his abundance.

verse_text_en: For with you is the spring of life. In your light shall we see light.
verse_text_es:
Porque en ti está la fuente de la vida
y en tu luz podemos ver la luz.
verse_text_bilingual:
For with you is the spring of life. In your light shall we see light.

Porque en ti está la fuente de la vida
y en tu luz podemos ver la luz.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's presence is described as a source of life and light.

verse_text_en: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
verse_text_es:
Deléitate en el Señor
y él te concederá los deseos de tu corazón.
verse_text_bilingual:
Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

Deléitate en el Señor
y él te concederá los deseos de tu corazón.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises to give the desires of the heart to those who delight in him.

verse_text_en: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
verse_text_es:
Encomienda al Señor tu camino;
confía en él y él actuará.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God assures trust in him will lead to a specific outcome (he will do this)

verse_text_en: he will make your righteousness go forth as the light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
verse_text_es:
Hará que tu justicia resplandezca como el alba;
tu justa causa, como el sol de mediodía.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's righteousness and justice are described as going forth as light and sun, indicating protection and illumination.

verse_text_en: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.
verse_text_es:
Porque los malvados serán exterminados,
pero los que esperan en el Señor heredarán la tierra.
verse_text_bilingual:
For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.

Porque los malvados serán exterminados,
pero los que esperan en el Señor heredarán la tierra.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise of protection and inheritance for those who wait on him.

verse_text_en: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn't there.
verse_text_es:
Dentro de poco los malvados dejarán de existir;
por más que los busques, no los encontrarás.
promise_type_description: God rescues His people from bondage, danger or judgment.
why_promise: God commits to removing the wicked from the scene, which is a promise of deliverance from evil.

verse_text_en: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verse_text_es:
Pero los humildes heredarán la tierra
y disfrutarán de gran bienestar.
verse_text_bilingual:
But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

Pero los humildes heredarán la tierra
y disfrutarán de gran bienestar.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises a future inheritance of peace and abundance to the humble.

verse_text_en: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
verse_text_es:
pero el Señor se ríe de los malvados,
pues sabe que les llegará su hora.
verse_text_bilingual:
The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

pero el Señor se ríe de los malvados,
pues sabe que les llegará su hora.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's laughter implies protection and deliverance from the consequences of the wicked.

verse_text_en: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.
verse_text_es:
Pero su propia espada les atravesará el corazón
y su arco quedará hecho pedazos.
verse_text_bilingual:
Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

Pero su propia espada les atravesará el corazón
y su arco quedará hecho pedazos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise of protection and deliverance from enemies.

verse_text_en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.
verse_text_es:
porque el brazo de los malvados será quebrado,
pero el Señor sostendrá a los justos.
verse_text_bilingual:
For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.

porque el brazo de los malvados será quebrado,
pero el Señor sostendrá a los justos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to protect and uphold the righteous.

verse_text_en: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
verse_text_es:
El Señor conoce la vida de los íntegros,
y su herencia perdura por siempre.
verse_text_bilingual:
Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

El Señor conoce la vida de los íntegros,
y su herencia perdura por siempre.
promise_type_description: A divine commitment that does not fit the other categories.
why_promise: God's promise of eternal inheritance to the righteous.

verse_text_en: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verse_text_es:
En tiempos difíciles no serán avergonzados;
en épocas de hambre tendrán abundancia.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God assures his people that he will provide for them even in times of famine.

verse_text_en: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish-- vanish like smoke.
verse_text_es:
Los malvados, los enemigos del Señor,
acabarán por ser destruidos;
desaparecerán como las flores silvestres,
se desvanecerán como el humo.
verse_text_bilingual:
But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish-- vanish like smoke.

Los malvados, los enemigos del Señor,
acabarán por ser destruidos;
desaparecerán como las flores silvestres,
se desvanecerán como el humo.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise of judgment and destruction of the wicked.

verse_text_en: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
verse_text_es:
Los benditos del Señor heredarán la tierra,
pero los que él maldice serán exterminados.
verse_text_bilingual:
For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

Los benditos del Señor heredarán la tierra,
pero los que él maldice serán exterminados.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God's blessing is tied to inheritance of the land.

verse_text_en: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
verse_text_es:
podrá tropezar, pero no caerá,
porque el Señor lo sostiene de la mano.
verse_text_bilingual:
Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.

podrá tropezar, pero no caerá,
porque el Señor lo sostiene de la mano.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to hold and support his people.

verse_text_en: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn't forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
verse_text_es:
Porque el Señor ama al justo
y no abandona a quienes le son fieles. El Señor los protegerá para siempre,
pero la descendencia de los malvados será exterminada.
verse_text_bilingual:
For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn't forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

Porque el Señor ama al justo
y no abandona a quienes le son fieles. El Señor los protegerá para siempre,
pero la descendencia de los malvados será exterminada.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's love for justice and his commitment to protect his saints.

verse_text_en: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
verse_text_es:
Los justos heredarán la tierra
y por siempre vivirán en ella.
verse_text_bilingual:
The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

Los justos heredarán la tierra
y por siempre vivirán en ella.
promise_type_description: A divine commitment that does not fit the other categories.
why_promise: God's promise of eternal inheritance to the righteous.

verse_text_en: Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
verse_text_es:
pero el Señor no los dejará caer en sus manos
ni permitirá que los condenen en el juicio.
verse_text_bilingual:
Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

pero el Señor no los dejará caer en sus manos
ni permitirá que los condenen en el juicio.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to deliver and protect his people from judgment.

verse_text_en: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
verse_text_es:
Pero tú, espera en el Señor
y sigue su camino,
que él te exaltará para que heredes la tierra.
Cuando los malvados sean exterminados,
tú lo verás con tus propios ojos.
verse_text_bilingual:
Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

Pero tú, espera en el Señor
y sigue su camino,
que él te exaltará para que heredes la tierra.
Cuando los malvados sean exterminados,
tú lo verás con tus propios ojos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise of protection and inheritance for those who wait on him.

verse_text_en: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
verse_text_es:
Pero todos los transgresores serán destruidos;
el porvenir de los malvados será el exterminio.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to protect his people from the wicked.

verse_text_en: For in you, Yahweh, do I hope. You will answer, Lord my God.
verse_text_es:
Yo, Señor, espero en ti;
tú, Señor y Dios mío, serás quien responda.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's answer is a source of hope and comfort for the psalmist.

verse_text_en: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart."
verse_text_es:
Me agrada, Dios mío, hacer tu voluntad;
tu Ley la llevo dentro de mí».
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's will is within the psalmist's heart, indicating a deep commitment to following God's guidance.

verse_text_en: Blessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.
verse_text_es:
Dichoso el que piensa en el débil;
el Señor lo librará en el día de la desgracia.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to deliver the one who considers the poor in times of evil.

verse_text_en: Yahweh will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.
verse_text_bilingual:
Yahweh will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

El Señor lo protegerá y lo mantendrá con vida;
lo hará dichoso en la tierra
y no lo entregará al capricho de sus enemigos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to preserve and keep someone safe from harm.

verse_text_en: Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
verse_text_es:
El Señor lo sostendrá en el lecho del dolor;
cuando caiga enfermo lo restaurará.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to sustain and restore the afflicted person.

verse_text_en: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
verse_text_es:
¿Por qué estás tan abatida, alma mía?
¿Por qué estás tan angustiada?
En Dios pondré mi esperanza
y lo seguiré alabando.
¡Él es mi salvación y mi Dios!
verse_text_bilingual:
Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

¿Por qué estás tan abatida, alma mía?
¿Por qué estás tan angustiada?
En Dios pondré mi esperanza
y lo seguiré alabando.
¡Él es mi salvación y mi Dios!
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's presence is a source of hope and guidance for the psalmist.

verse_text_en: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
verse_text_es:
¿Por qué estás tan abatida, alma mía?
¿Por qué estás angustiada?
En Dios pondré mi esperanza
y lo seguiré alabando.
¡Él es mi salvación y mi Dios!
verse_text_bilingual:
Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

¿Por qué estás tan abatida, alma mía?
¿Por qué estás angustiada?
En Dios pondré mi esperanza
y lo seguiré alabando.
¡Él es mi salvación y mi Dios!
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's presence and help are a source of hope and encouragement for the psalmist.

verse_text_en: Through you, will we push down our adversaries. Through your name, will we tread them under who rise up against us.
verse_text_es:
Por ti derrotamos a nuestros enemigos;
en tu nombre aplastamos a nuestros agresores.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's name is used as a means of protection and deliverance for his people.

verse_text_en: All this has come on us, yet have we not forgotten you, Neither have we been false to your covenant.
verse_text_es:
Todo esto nos ha sucedido,
a pesar de que nunca te olvidamos
ni faltamos jamás a tu pacto.
verse_text_bilingual:
All this has come on us, yet have we not forgotten you, Neither have we been false to your covenant.

Todo esto nos ha sucedido,
a pesar de que nunca te olvidamos
ni faltamos jamás a tu pacto.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: David affirms God's covenant with Israel, despite their disobedience.

verse_text_en: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.
verse_text_es:
Tus hijos ocuparán el trono de tus ancestros;
los pondrás por príncipes en toda la tierra.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises to elevate the descendants of David to positions of power and authority.

verse_text_en: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever. For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth.
verse_text_es:
Haré que tu nombre se recuerde por todas las generaciones;
por eso las naciones te alabarán eternamente y para siempre.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God promises to make David's name remembered for generations to come.

verse_text_en: God is in her midst. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.
verse_text_es:
Dios está en ella, la ciudad no caerá;
al rayar el alba Dios le brindará su ayuda.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's presence and help are a promise of safety and security.

verse_text_en: "Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth."
verse_text_es:
«Quédense quietos, reconozcan que yo soy Dios.
¡Seré exaltado entre las naciones!
¡Seré enaltecido en la tierra!».
verse_text_bilingual:
"Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth."

«Quédense quietos, reconozcan que yo soy Dios.
¡Seré exaltado entre las naciones!
¡Seré enaltecido en la tierra!».
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's declaration of his sovereignty and power over the nations.

verse_text_en: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.
verse_text_es:
Pero Dios me rescatará de las garras de la muerte
y con él me llevará.
verse_text_bilingual:
But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.

Pero Dios me rescatará de las garras de la muerte
y con él me llevará.
promise_type_description: A divine commitment that does not fit the other categories.
why_promise: God commits to redeem the psalmist's soul from death.

verse_text_en: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me."
verse_text_es:
Invócame en el día de la angustia;
yo te libraré y tú me honrarás».
promise_type_description: God rescues His people from bondage, danger or judgment.
why_promise: God promises to deliver those who call on him in times of trouble.

verse_text_en: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners shall be converted to you.
verse_text_es:
Así enseñaré a los transgresores tus caminos,
y los pecadores se volverán a ti.
verse_text_bilingual:
Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners shall be converted to you.

Así enseñaré a los transgresores tus caminos,
y los pecadores se volverán a ti.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God promises to teach and guide those who are transgressing, and to convert sinners to himself.

verse_text_en: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue shall sing aloud of your righteousness.
verse_text_es:
Dios mío, Dios de mi salvación,
líbrame de derramar sangre
y mi lengua alabará tu justicia.
verse_text_bilingual:
Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue shall sing aloud of your righteousness.

Dios mío, Dios de mi salvación,
líbrame de derramar sangre
y mi lengua alabará tu justicia.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to deliver and protect David from sin and guilt.

verse_text_en: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. A broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.
verse_text_es:
El sacrificio que te agrada
es un espíritu quebrantado;
tú, oh Dios, no desprecias
al corazón quebrantado y arrepentido.
verse_text_bilingual:
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. A broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.

El sacrificio que te agrada
es un espíritu quebrantado;
tú, oh Dios, no desprecias
al corazón quebrantado y arrepentido.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises not to despise a broken and contrite heart, indicating protection and acceptance.

verse_text_en: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
verse_text_es:
Hará recaer el mal sobre mis enemigos.
Por tu fidelidad, Señor, ¡destrúyelos!
verse_text_bilingual:
He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

Hará recaer el mal sobre mis enemigos.
Por tu fidelidad, Señor, ¡destrúyelos!
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to repay evil to his enemies and destroy them in his truth.

verse_text_en: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
verse_text_es:
En la noche, en la mañana y al mediodía,
clamo angustiado y él me escucha.
verse_text_bilingual:
Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

En la noche, en la mañana y al mediodía,
clamo angustiado y él me escucha.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to hear and respond to the psalmist's cries for help.

verse_text_en: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear, and answer them. Selah. They never change, who don't fear God.
verse_text_es:
¡Dios, que reina desde la eternidad,
habrá de oírme y los afligirá! Esa gente no cambia de conducta,
pues no tiene temor de Dios.
verse_text_bilingual:
God, who is enthroned forever, will hear, and answer them. Selah. They never change, who don't fear God.

¡Dios, que reina desde la eternidad,
habrá de oírme y los afligirá! Esa gente no cambia de conducta,
pues no tiene temor de Dios.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to hear and answer those who fear him.

verse_text_en: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.
verse_text_es:
Levantan la mano contra sus amigos
y no cumplen sus compromisos.
verse_text_bilingual:
He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

Levantan la mano contra sus amigos
y no cumplen sus compromisos.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God's covenant is being broken by someone's actions, implying a commitment made by God to his people.

verse_text_en: Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
verse_text_es:
Entrégale tus afanes al Señor
y él te sostendrá;
no permitirá que el justo caiga
y quede abatido para siempre.
verse_text_bilingual:
Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

Entrégale tus afanes al Señor
y él te sostendrá;
no permitirá que el justo caiga
y quede abatido para siempre.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to sustain and protect the righteous.

verse_text_en: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Silent Dove in Distant Lands." A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath.
verse_text_es:
Tú, oh Dios, abatirás a los impíos
y los arrojarás en la fosa de la muerte;
la gente sanguinaria y mentirosa
no llegará ni a la mitad de su vida.
Yo, por mi parte, en ti confío.
verse_text_bilingual:
But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Silent Dove in Distant Lands." A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath.

Tú, oh Dios, abatirás a los impíos
y los arrojarás en la fosa de la muerte;
la gente sanguinaria y mentirosa
no llegará ni a la mitad de su vida.
Yo, por mi parte, en ti confío.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to protect David from his enemies.

verse_text_en: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
verse_text_es: Cuando siento miedo, pongo en ti mi confianza.
verse_text_bilingual:
When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

Cuando siento miedo, pongo en ti mi confianza.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's presence and protection is assured to David when he is afraid, as he commits to trust in God.

verse_text_en: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
verse_text_bilingual:
In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

Confío en Dios y alabo su palabra;
confío en Dios y no siento miedo.
¿Qué puede hacerme un simple mortal?
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: The psalmist expresses trust in God and asserts that he will not be afraid, which implies God's protection.

verse_text_en: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this, that God is for me.
verse_text_es:
Cuando yo te pida ayuda,
mis enemigos retrocederán.
Una cosa sé: ¡Dios está de mi parte!
verse_text_bilingual:
Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this, that God is for me.

Cuando yo te pida ayuda,
mis enemigos retrocederán.
Una cosa sé: ¡Dios está de mi parte!
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's presence and power are a guarantee of protection and safety for the speaker.

verse_text_en: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
verse_text_es:
confío en Dios y no siento miedo.
¿Qué puede hacerme un simple mortal?
verse_text_bilingual:
I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

confío en Dios y no siento miedo.
¿Qué puede hacerme un simple mortal?
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: The psalmist expresses trust in God and asserts that God's presence will protect him from harm.

verse_text_en: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.
verse_text_es:
Ten piedad de mí, oh Dios;
ten piedad de mí, pues en ti me refugio.
A la sombra de tus alas me refugiaré,
hasta que haya pasado el peligro.
verse_text_bilingual:
Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

Ten piedad de mí, oh Dios;
ten piedad de mí, pues en ti me refugio.
A la sombra de tus alas me refugiaré,
hasta que haya pasado el peligro.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's mercy and protection are offered to the psalmist as a refuge from disaster.

verse_text_en: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.
verse_text_es:
Desde el cielo me envía la salvación
y reprende a mis perseguidores. ¡Dios me envía su gran amor y su verdad!
verse_text_bilingual:
He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

Desde el cielo me envía la salvación
y reprende a mis perseguidores. ¡Dios me envía su gran amor y su verdad!
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to send help and protection to the psalmist.

verse_text_en: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
verse_text_es:
Tú eres el Dios en quien puedo confiar.
Tú irás delante de mí
para hacerme ver la derrota de mis enemigos.
verse_text_bilingual:
My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

Tú eres el Dios en quien puedo confiar.
Tú irás delante de mí
para hacerme ver la derrota de mis enemigos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's loving kindness and presence will protect and empower David.

verse_text_en: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
verse_text_es:
Dios ha dicho en su santuario:
«Triunfante repartiré a Siquén
y dividiré el valle de Sucot.
verse_text_bilingual:
God has spoken from his sanctuary: "I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

Dios ha dicho en su santuario:
«Triunfante repartiré a Siquén
y dividiré el valle de Sucot.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's declaration of future triumph and division of Shechem, indicating a promise of protection and victory.

verse_text_en: Through God we shall do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries. For the Chief Musician. For a stringed instrument. By David.
verse_text_es:
Con Dios obtendremos la victoria;
¡él aplastará a nuestros enemigos!
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's presence and power will protect and deliver Israel.

verse_text_en: From the end of the earth, I will call to you, when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verse_text_bilingual:
From the end of the earth, I will call to you, when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

Desde los confines de la tierra te invoco,
pues mi corazón desfallece;
llévame a una roca que es más alta que yo.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to lead the psalmist to a place of refuge and safety.

verse_text_en: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.
verse_text_es:
Anhelo habitar en tu santuario para siempre
y refugiarme debajo de tus alas.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

Anhelo habitar en tu santuario para siempre
y refugiarme debajo de tus alas.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise of refuge and shelter, a commitment to protect and care for his people.

verse_text_en: You will prolong the king's life; his years shall be for generations.
verse_text_es:
Concédele al rey más años de vida;
que sus años duren por generaciones.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to preserve and extend the king's life.

verse_text_en: He shall be enthroned in God's presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
verse_text_es:
Que reine siempre en tu presencia,
y que tu gran amor y tu verdad lo protejan.
verse_text_bilingual:
He shall be enthroned in God's presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

Que reine siempre en tu presencia,
y que tu gran amor y tu verdad lo protejan.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's promise to preserve and guide the psalmist, emphasizing his enthronement in God's presence.

verse_text_en: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
verse_text_es:
Te bendeciré mientras viva
y alzando mis manos te invocaré.
verse_text_bilingual:
So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

Te bendeciré mientras viva
y alzando mis manos te invocaré.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: David's vow to bless God while he lives.

verse_text_en: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
verse_text_es:
A la sombra de tus alas canto de alegría,
porque tú eres mi ayuda.
verse_text_bilingual:
For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

A la sombra de tus alas canto de alegría,
porque tú eres mi ayuda.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's presence and help are described as a source of comfort and protection.

verse_text_en: But those who seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
verse_text_es:
Los que buscan mi muerte serán destruidos;
bajarán a las profundidades de la tierra.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect those who seek his soul.

verse_text_en: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.
verse_text_es:
Pero Dios les disparará sus flechas
y sin aviso caerán heridos.
verse_text_bilingual:
But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

Pero Dios les disparará sus flechas
y sin aviso caerán heridos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect David from his enemies.

verse_text_en: You who hear prayer, to you all men will come.
verse_text_es:
Tú escuchas la oración,
a ti acude todo mortal.
verse_text_bilingual:
You who hear prayer, to you all men will come.

Tú escuchas la oración,
a ti acude todo mortal.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God hears and answers prayer, promising that all men will come to him.

verse_text_en: Blessed is one whom you choose, and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.
verse_text_es:
¡Dichoso aquel a quien tú escoges,
al que atraes a ti para que viva en tus atrios!
Saciémonos de los bienes de tu casa,
de los dones de tu santo Templo.
verse_text_bilingual:
Blessed is one whom you choose, and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

¡Dichoso aquel a quien tú escoges,
al que atraes a ti para que viva en tus atrios!
Saciémonos de los bienes de tu casa,
de los dones de tu santo Templo.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God's choice and presence are blessings, promising a life of joy and goodness.

verse_text_en: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name." Selah.
verse_text_bilingual:
All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name." Selah.

Toda la tierra se postra en tu presencia
y te canta salmos;
canta salmos a tu nombre».
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's people will worship and praise Him, indicating His protection and care.

verse_text_en: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.
verse_text_es:
La tierra dará entonces su fruto,
y Dios, nuestro Dios, nos bendecirá.
verse_text_bilingual:
The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

La tierra dará entonces su fruto,
y Dios, nuestro Dios, nos bendecirá.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God's blessing is expressed as a result of the earth's yield, indicating a promise of God's favor.

verse_text_en: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him. For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song.
verse_text_es:
Dios nos bendecirá
y le temerán todos los confines de la tierra.
verse_text_bilingual:
God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him. For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song.

Dios nos bendecirá
y le temerán todos los confines de la tierra.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God's blessing is a promise made to his people, expressed through the psalmist David.

verse_text_en: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there forever.
verse_text_es:
¿Por qué, montañas escarpadas, miran con envidia
al monte donde a Dios le place residir,
donde el Señor habitará por siempre?
verse_text_bilingual:
Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there forever.

¿Por qué, montañas escarpadas, miran con envidia
al monte donde a Dios le place residir,
donde el Señor habitará por siempre?
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's presence and reign are established on the mountain, indicating a place of safety and refuge.

verse_text_en: The Lord said, "I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea;
verse_text_es:
El Señor dice: «De Basán los regresaré;
de las profundidades del mar los haré volver,
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to bring the Israelites back to their homeland.

verse_text_en: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.
verse_text_es:
Egipto enviará embajadores,
y Cus presentará sus tributos a Dios.
verse_text_bilingual:
Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

Egipto enviará embajadores,
y Cus presentará sus tributos a Dios.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises to bring princes from Egypt and Ethiopia to worship him.

verse_text_en: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.
verse_text_es:
porque Dios salvará a Sión
y reconstruirá las ciudades de Judá.
Allí se establecerá el pueblo
y tomará posesión de la tierra.
verse_text_bilingual:
For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.

porque Dios salvará a Sión
y reconstruirá las ciudades de Judá.
Allí se establecerá el pueblo
y tomará posesión de la tierra.
promise_type_description: God brings His people back into a right relationship.
why_promise: God's promise to restore and rebuild the cities of Judah.

verse_text_en: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein. For the Chief Musician. By David. A reminder.
verse_text_es:
La heredarán los hijos de sus siervos;
la habitarán los que aman su nombre.
promise_type_description: A divine commitment that does not fit the other categories.
why_promise: God's promise to his people, specifically those who love his name, to inherit the land.

verse_text_en: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother's womb. I will always praise you.
verse_text_bilingual:
I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother's womb. I will always praise you.
