Desde el vientre de mi madre dependo de ti;
desde el seno materno me has sostenido.
¡Por siempre te alabaré!
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's protection and care for the psalmist from birth.

verse_text_en: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all the day.
verse_text_es:
Mi boca rebosa de tu alabanza
y todo el día proclama tu grandeza.
verse_text_bilingual:
My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all the day.

Mi boca rebosa de tu alabanza
y todo el día proclama tu grandeza.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise of protection and preservation for David's praise and honor.

verse_text_en: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
verse_text_es:
Pero yo siempre tendré esperanza
y más y más te alabaré.
verse_text_bilingual:
But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.

Pero yo siempre tendré esperanza
y más y más te alabaré.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God promises to always hope with the psalmist and add to his praise.

verse_text_en: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don't know its full measure.
verse_text_es:
Todo el día proclamará mi boca
tu justicia y tu salvación,
aunque es algo que no alcanzo a descifrar.
verse_text_bilingual:
My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don't know its full measure.

Todo el día proclamará mi boca
tu justicia y tu salvación,
aunque es algo que no alcanzo a descifrar.
promise_type_description: God saves His people from sin and gives eternal life.
why_promise: The psalmist expresses his intention to proclaim God's righteousness and salvation, implying God's commitment to salvation.

verse_text_en: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
verse_text_es:
Mi Señor y Dios, relataré tus obras poderosas
y haré memoria de tu justicia,
de tu justicia solamente.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

Mi Señor y Dios, relataré tus obras poderosas
y haré memoria de tu justicia,
de tu justicia solamente.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God promises to make mention of the righteous person's righteousness, implying a public acknowledgment and recognition.

verse_text_en: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.
verse_text_es:
Me has hecho pasar por muchas angustias y males,
pero volverás a darme vida;
de las profundidades de la tierra
volverás a levantarme.
verse_text_bilingual:
You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

Me has hecho pasar por muchas angustias y males,
pero volverás a darme vida;
de las profundidades de la tierra
volverás a levantarme.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to rescue and protect the psalmist from troubles.

verse_text_en: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
verse_text_es:
Así juzgará con justicia a tu pueblo
y con juicios justos a tus pobres.
verse_text_bilingual:
He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.

Así juzgará con justicia a tu pueblo
y con juicios justos a tus pobres.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to judge his people with righteousness and protect the poor.

verse_text_en: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.
verse_text_es:
Brindarán los montes la paz al pueblo
y las colinas, la justicia.
verse_text_bilingual:
The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

Brindarán los montes la paz al pueblo
y las colinas, la justicia.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises that the natural world will bring blessings to his people.

verse_text_en: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
verse_text_es:
El rey defenderá la causa de los pobres del pueblo,
salvará a los necesitados
y aplastará a los opresores.
verse_text_bilingual:
He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.

El rey defenderá la causa de los pobres del pueblo,
salvará a los necesitados
y aplastará a los opresores.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to judge the poor and oppressor, and to save the needy.

verse_text_en: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.
verse_text_es:
Que viva el rey como el sol y como la luna,
a través de las generaciones.
verse_text_bilingual:
They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

Que viva el rey como el sol y como la luna,
a través de las generaciones.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's protection and fear-inducing presence is described as enduring throughout generations.
condition_clause: as long as the moon, throughout all generations

verse_text_en: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
verse_text_es:
Que sea como la lluvia que cae sobre un campo segado,
como los aguaceros que empapan la tierra.
verse_text_bilingual:
He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

Que sea como la lluvia que cae sobre un campo segado,
como los aguaceros que empapan la tierra.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God's blessing brings fertility and abundance, like rain on the earth.

verse_text_en: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.
verse_text_es:
Que en sus días florezca la justicia,
y que abunde la paz,
hasta que la luna deje de existir.
verse_text_bilingual:
In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

Que en sus días florezca la justicia,
y que abunde la paz,
hasta que la luna deje de existir.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises that in the days of a righteous ruler, there will be an abundance of peace.

verse_text_en: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
verse_text_es:
Que domine el rey de mar a mar,
desde el río Éufrates hasta los confines de la tierra.
verse_text_bilingual:
He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

Que domine el rey de mar a mar,
desde el río Éufrates hasta los confines de la tierra.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God's promise of dominion and control over all nations and territories.

verse_text_en: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.
verse_text_es:
Que se postren ante él las tribus del desierto;
que muerdan el polvo sus enemigos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's protection and deliverance of his people is promised.

verse_text_en: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
verse_text_es:
Que le paguen tributo los reyes de Tarsis
y de las costas remotas;
que los reyes de Sabá y de Seba
le traigan presentes.
verse_text_bilingual:
The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

Que le paguen tributo los reyes de Tarsis
y de las costas remotas;
que los reyes de Sabá y de Seba
le traigan presentes.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises that kings from far-off lands will bring tribute and gifts.

verse_text_en: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
verse_text_es:
Que ante él se postren todos los reyes;
que le sirvan todas las naciones.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise of protection and dominion over all nations and kings.

verse_text_en: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
verse_text_es:
Él librará al indigente que pide auxilio
y al pobre que no tiene quien lo ayude.
verse_text_bilingual:
For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

Él librará al indigente que pide auxilio
y al pobre que no tiene quien lo ayude.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to deliver the needy when they cry.

verse_text_en: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.
verse_text_es:
Se compadecerá del desvalido y del necesitado
y a los menesterosos les salvará la vida.
verse_text_bilingual:
He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

Se compadecerá del desvalido y del necesitado
y a los menesterosos les salvará la vida.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to show compassion and deliver the needy.

verse_text_en: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.
verse_text_es:
Los librará de la opresión y la violencia,
porque considera valiosa su vida.
verse_text_bilingual:
He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

Los librará de la opresión y la violencia,
porque considera valiosa su vida.
promise_type_description: A divine commitment that does not fit the other categories.
why_promise: God's commitment to redeem and value the lives of his people.

verse_text_en: They shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba. Men shall pray for him continually. They shall bless him all day long.
verse_text_es:
¡Que viva el rey!
¡Que se le entregue el oro de Sabá!
Que se ore por él sin cesar;
que todos los días se le bendiga.
verse_text_bilingual:
They shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba. Men shall pray for him continually. They shall bless him all day long.

¡Que viva el rey!
¡Que se le entregue el oro de Sabá!
Que se ore por él sin cesar;
que todos los días se le bendiga.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God's blessing on the king, with continued prayer and blessing throughout his life.

verse_text_en: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises abundance and prosperity to the righteous.

verse_text_en: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God's blessing is described as enduring and universal, extending to all nations.
condition_clause: as long as the sun

verse_text_en: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
verse_text_es:
Me guías con tu consejo
y más tarde me acogerás en gloria.
verse_text_bilingual:
You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

Me guías con tu consejo
y más tarde me acogerás en gloria.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God promises to guide the psalmist with his counsel.

verse_text_en: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.
verse_text_es:
Tú dices: «Cuando yo lo decida,
juzgaré con equidad.
verse_text_bilingual:
When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.

Tú dices: «Cuando yo lo decida,
juzgaré con equidad.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God commits to judge and protect his people at the appointed time.

verse_text_en: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?
verse_text_es:
¿Se habrá agotado para siempre su gran amor
y su promesa por todas las generaciones?
verse_text_bilingual:
Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

¿Se habrá agotado para siempre su gran amor
y su promesa por todas las generaciones?
promise_type_description: A divine commitment that does not fit the other categories.
why_promise: Psalmist expresses doubt about God's promise, but still refers to it as a promise.

verse_text_en: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide flesh for his people?"
verse_text_es:
Cuando golpeó la roca,
el agua brotó en torrentes;
pero, ¿podrá también darnos de comer?
¿Podrá proveerle carne a su pueblo?».
verse_text_bilingual:
Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide flesh for his people?"

Cuando golpeó la roca,
el agua brotó en torrentes;
pero, ¿podrá también darnos de comer?
¿Podrá proveerle carne a su pueblo?».
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God's actions are questioned, implying a promise of provision for his people.

verse_text_en: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
verse_text_es:
¡Restáuranos, oh Dios!
¡Haz resplandecer tu rostro sobre nosotros,
y sálvanos!
verse_text_bilingual:
Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

¡Restáuranos, oh Dios!
¡Haz resplandecer tu rostro sobre nosotros,
y sálvanos!
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's face shining is a metaphor for his presence and salvation.

verse_text_en: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.
verse_text_es:
Entonces no nos apartaremos de ti;
reavívanos e invocaremos tu nombre.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's response to Israel's plea, promising to revive and protect them.

verse_text_en: "Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!
verse_text_es:
»Escucha, pueblo mío, mis advertencias;
¡ay, Israel, si tan solo me escucharas!
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: Although the verse is phrased as a call to listen, the context implies that God is committing to testify to Israel if they listen.
condition_clause: if you would listen to me

verse_text_en: I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verse_text_es:
Yo soy el Señor tu Dios,
que te hice subir de la tierra de Egipto.
Abre bien la boca, y te la llenaré.
verse_text_bilingual:
I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

Yo soy el Señor tu Dios,
que te hice subir de la tierra de Egipto.
Abre bien la boca, y te la llenaré.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises to fill the prophet's mouth with his words.

verse_text_en: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock." A Psalm by Asaph.
verse_text_es:
Y a ti te alimentaría con lo mejor del trigo;
con miel de la roca te saciaría».
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises to provide for Israel's needs, including food, with honey from a rock.

verse_text_en: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
verse_text_es:
El Señor es sol y escudo;
Dios nos concede honor y gloria.
El Señor no niega sus bondades
a los que se conducen con integridad.
verse_text_bilingual:
For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

El Señor es sol y escudo;
Dios nos concede honor y gloria.
El Señor no niega sus bondades
a los que se conducen con integridad.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God commits to giving grace and glory, and withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly, indicating a protective and beneficial relationship.

verse_text_en: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.
verse_text_es:
Voy a escuchar lo que Dios el Señor dice:
él promete paz a su pueblo y a sus fieles,
para que no se vuelvan a la necedad.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

Voy a escuchar lo que Dios el Señor dice:
él promete paz a su pueblo y a sus fieles,
para que no se vuelvan a la necedad.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise of speaking peace to his people, his saints.

verse_text_en: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.
verse_text_es:
El Señor mismo nos dará bienestar
y nuestra tierra rendirá su fruto.
verse_text_bilingual:
Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

El Señor mismo nos dará bienestar
y nuestra tierra rendirá su fruto.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises to bless the land and its increase.

verse_text_en: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
verse_text_es:
En el día de mi angustia te invoco,
porque tú me respondes.
verse_text_bilingual:
In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

En el día de mi angustia te invoco,
porque tú me respondes.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to answer the prayers of the afflicted.

verse_text_en: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.
verse_text_es:
Todas las naciones que has hecho
vendrán, Señor, y ante ti se postrarán
y glorificarán tu nombre.
verse_text_bilingual:
All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

Todas las naciones que has hecho
vendrán, Señor, y ante ti se postrarán
y glorificarán tu nombre.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's protection and worship of all nations is a promise made to humanity.

verse_text_en: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
verse_text_es:
Instrúyeme, Señor, en tu camino
para conducirme con fidelidad.
Dame integridad de corazón
para temer tu nombre.
verse_text_bilingual:
Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

Instrúyeme, Señor, en tu camino
para conducirme con fidelidad.
Dame integridad de corazón
para temer tu nombre.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God promises to teach and guide the psalmist.

verse_text_en: Yes, of Zion it will be said, "This one and that one was born in her;" the Most High himself will establish her.
verse_text_es:
De Sión se dirá, en efecto:
«Este y aquel nacieron en ella.
El Altísimo mismo la ha establecido».
verse_text_bilingual:
Yes, of Zion it will be said, "This one and that one was born in her;" the Most High himself will establish her.

De Sión se dirá, en efecto:
«Este y aquel nacieron en ella.
El Altísimo mismo la ha establecido».
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's commitment to protect and establish Zion.

verse_text_en: "I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,
verse_text_es:
Dijiste: «He hecho un pacto con mi escogido;
le he jurado a David mi siervo:
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to David, his chosen servant, through this covenant.

verse_text_en: 'I will establish your seed forever, and build up your throne to all generations.'" Selah.
verse_text_es:
“Estableceré tu descendencia para siempre
y afirmaré tu trono por todas las generaciones”».
verse_text_bilingual:
'I will establish your seed forever, and build up your throne to all generations.'" Selah.

“Estableceré tu descendencia para siempre
y afirmaré tu trono por todas las generaciones”».
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God's commitment to establish David's seed and build up his throne is a covenant promise.

verse_text_en: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.
verse_text_es:
Mi mano siempre lo sostendrá;
mi brazo lo fortalecerá.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God commits to establish and strengthen a king, indicating a promise of protection and support.

verse_text_en: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
verse_text_es:
Ningún enemigo lo someterá a tributo;
ningún malvado lo oprimirá.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise of protection for the righteous king David.

verse_text_en: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.
verse_text_es:
Aplastaré a quienes se le enfrenten
y derribaré a quienes lo aborrezcan.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

Aplastaré a quienes se le enfrenten
y derribaré a quienes lo aborrezcan.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to protect and defend David.

verse_text_en: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.
verse_text_es:
La fidelidad de mi gran amor lo acompañará,
y por mi nombre será exaltada su fuerza.
verse_text_bilingual:
But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

La fidelidad de mi gran amor lo acompañará,
y por mi nombre será exaltada su fuerza.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to maintain his faithfulness and loving kindness towards David.

verse_text_en: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
verse_text_es:
Le daré poder sobre el mar
y dominio sobre los ríos.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

Le daré poder sobre el mar
y dominio sobre los ríos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to protect and guide David, extended to his descendants.

verse_text_en: He will call to me, 'You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!'
verse_text_es:
Él me dirá: “Tú eres mi Padre,
mi Dios, la Roca de mi salvación”.
verse_text_bilingual:
He will call to me, 'You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!'

Él me dirá: “Tú eres mi Padre,
mi Dios, la Roca de mi salvación”.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's self-identification as Father, God, and rock of salvation, indicating a personal and intimate relationship.

verse_text_en: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
verse_text_es:
Yo lo haré mi primogénito,
el rey supremo de la tierra.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

Yo lo haré mi primogénito,
el rey supremo de la tierra.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to appoint David as his firstborn and highest king.

verse_text_en: I will keep my loving kindness for him forevermore. My covenant will stand firm with him.
verse_text_es:
Mi gran amor por él será siempre constante,
y mi pacto con él será estable.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will keep my loving kindness for him forevermore. My covenant will stand firm with him.

Mi gran amor por él será siempre constante,
y mi pacto con él será estable.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to keeping his loving kindness and standing firm with David through a covenant.

verse_text_en: I will also make his seed endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
verse_text_es:
Afirmaré su descendencia para siempre;
su trono durará como el sol en mi presencia.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to establish David's dynasty forever.

verse_text_es: Da de comer a quienes le temen; siempre recuerda su pacto.
verse_text_bilingual:
He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

Da de comer a quienes le temen; siempre recuerda su pacto.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God's covenant is remembered and fulfilled through his provision for those who fear him.

verse_text_en: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
verse_text_es: Pagó el precio del rescate de su pueblo y estableció su pacto para siempre. Su nombre es santo y temible.
verse_text_bilingual:
He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

Pagó el precio del rescate de su pueblo y estableció su pacto para siempre. Su nombre es santo y temible.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God's covenant with his people is ordained forever.

verse_text_en: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
verse_text_es: El justo jamás caerá; su recuerdo permanecerá para siempre.
verse_text_bilingual:
For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.

El justo jamás caerá; su recuerdo permanecerá para siempre.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise of stability and remembrance for the righteous.

verse_text_en: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.
verse_text_es: No temerá recibir malas noticias; su corazón estará firme, confiado en el Señor.
verse_text_bilingual:
He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.

No temerá recibir malas noticias; su corazón estará firme, confiado en el Señor.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise of protection and steadfastness in the face of evil news.

verse_text_en: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
verse_text_es: Su corazón estará seguro, sin temor alguno, y al final verá derrotados a sus adversarios.
verse_text_bilingual:
His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

Su corazón estará seguro, sin temor alguno, y al final verá derrotados a sus adversarios.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise of protection and safety for the righteous.

verse_text_en: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
verse_text_es: Reparte sus bienes entre los pobres; su justicia permanece para siempre; su poder será gloriosamente exaltado.
verse_text_bilingual:
He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.

Reparte sus bienes entre los pobres; su justicia permanece para siempre; su poder será gloriosamente exaltado.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God's blessing on the righteous, promising his righteousness will endure forever.

verse_text_en: Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.
verse_text_es:
El Señor nos recuerda y nos bendice:
bendice a su pueblo Israel,
bendice a la familia de Aarón,
verse_text_bilingual:
Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

El Señor nos recuerda y nos bendice:
bendice a su pueblo Israel,
bendice a la familia de Aarón,
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God's promise to bless the house of Israel and Aaron, showing his remembrance and favor.

verse_text_en: He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.
verse_text_es:
bendice a los que temen al Señor,
bendice a grandes y pequeños.
verse_text_bilingual:
He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.

bendice a los que temen al Señor,
bendice a grandes y pequeños.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God commits to bless those who fear him.

verse_text_en: But we will bless Yah, from this time forth and forevermore. Praise Yah!
verse_text_es:
Somos nosotros los que alabamos al Señor
desde ahora y para siempre.
¡Aleluya!
verse_text_bilingual:
But we will bless Yah, from this time forth and forevermore. Praise Yah!

Somos nosotros los que alabamos al Señor
desde ahora y para siempre.
¡Aleluya!
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God is being praised and blessed, with a commitment to continue blessing from now on.

verse_text_en: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
verse_text_es:
Por cuanto él inclina a mí su oído,
lo invocaré toda mi vida.
verse_text_bilingual:
Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

Por cuanto él inclina a mí su oído,
lo invocaré toda mi vida.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's response to David's prayer is a commitment to protect and answer his prayers.
condition_clause: as long as I live

verse_text_en: What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?
verse_text_es:
¿Cómo puedo pagarle al Señor
por tanta bondad que me ha mostrado?
verse_text_bilingual:
What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?

¿Cómo puedo pagarle al Señor
por tanta bondad que me ha mostrado?
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: This verse expresses gratitude and a desire to give to God in return for his benefits.

verse_text_en: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
verse_text_es:
El Señor está conmigo y no tengo miedo;
¿qué me puede hacer un simple mortal?
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's presence and power assure the psalmist of safety and security.

verse_text_en: I will not die, but live, and declare Yah's works.
verse_text_es:
No he de morir; he de vivir
para proclamar las obras del Señor.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will not die, but live, and declare Yah's works.

No he de morir; he de vivir
para proclamar las obras del Señor.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise of protection and preservation of life.

verse_text_en: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.
verse_text_es:
Trata con bondad a este siervo tuyo;
así viviré y obedeceré tu palabra.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to protect and guide his servant who obeys his word.

verse_text_en: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.
verse_text_es:
Confirma tu promesa a este siervo,
para que seas temido.
verse_text_bilingual:
Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.

Confirma tu promesa a este siervo,
para que seas temido.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: David asks God to fulfill his promise, indicating a commitment made by God to David.

verse_text_en: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.
verse_text_es:
Así podré responder al que me desprecie,
porque yo confío en tu palabra.
verse_text_bilingual:
So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.

Así podré responder al que me desprecie,
porque yo confío en tu palabra.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's word is trusted as a source of protection and defense.

verse_text_en: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
verse_text_es:
Hablaré de tus mandatos delante de los reyes
y no seré avergonzado.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.

Hablaré de tus mandatos delante de los reyes
y no seré avergonzado.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's statutes will be upheld and protected, even in the face of opposition.

verse_text_en: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
verse_text_es:
Me doy prisa, no tardo nada
para cumplir tus mandamientos.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

Me doy prisa, no tardo nada
para cumplir tus mandamientos.
promise_type_description: A divine commitment that does not fit the other categories.
why_promise: Although the speaker is making a commitment to obey God's commandments, the verse is still a promise because it is a commitment made by a person (the speaker) to God, and it reflects a desire to please God.

verse_text_en: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
verse_text_es:
Los que te honran se regocijan al verme,
porque he puesto mi esperanza en tu palabra.
verse_text_bilingual:
Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.

Los que te honran se regocijan al verme,
porque he puesto mi esperanza en tu palabra.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's word gives hope and guidance to those who fear him.

verse_text_en: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.
verse_text_es:
Vuélvanse a mí los que te honran,
los que conocen tus mandatos.
verse_text_bilingual:
Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.

Vuélvanse a mí los que te honran,
los que conocen tus mandatos.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's promise to guide those who fear him.

verse_text_en: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?
verse_text_es:
¿Cuánto más vivirá este siervo tuyo?
¿Cuándo juzgarás a mis perseguidores?
verse_text_bilingual:
How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?

¿Cuánto más vivirá este siervo tuyo?
¿Cuándo juzgarás a mis perseguidores?
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: David expresses his trust in God's justice and timing.

verse_text_en: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.
verse_text_es:
Los malvados esperan destruirme,
pero yo me esfuerzo por entender tus mandatos.
verse_text_bilingual:
The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.

Los malvados esperan destruirme,
pero yo me esfuerzo por entender tus mandatos.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's statutes are a guiding principle for the psalmist's life.

verse_text_en: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
verse_text_es:
Defiéndeme y estaré a salvo;
siempre optaré por tus estatutos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to hold and protect the psalmist, expressed in covenant language.

verse_text_en: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.
verse_text_es:
Líbrame de la opresión humana,
y obedeceré tus preceptos.
verse_text_bilingual:
Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.

Líbrame de la opresión humana,
y obedeceré tus preceptos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to redeem and protect David from human oppression if he observes his precepts.

verse_text_en: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.
verse_text_es:
Con todo el corazón clamo a ti, Señor;
respóndeme, y obedeceré tus estatutos.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's promise to answer David's call and guide him in keeping his statutes.

verse_text_en: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.
verse_text_es:
Defiende mi causa y rescátame;
dame vida conforme a tu promesa.
promise_type_description: A divine commitment that does not fit the other categories.
why_promise: David asks God to redeem him according to his promise.

verse_text_en: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
verse_text_es:
No permitirá que tu pie resbale;
jamás duerme el que te cuida.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to keep and protect his people, even in their sleep.

verse_text_en: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
verse_text_es:
Jamás duerme ni se adormece
el que cuida de Israel.
verse_text_bilingual:
Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

Jamás duerme ni se adormece
el que cuida de Israel.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's commitment to keep and protect Israel is expressed in this verse.

verse_text_en: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
verse_text_es:
De día el sol no te hará daño
ni la luna de noche.
verse_text_bilingual:
The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

De día el sol no te hará daño
ni la luna de noche.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God commits to protect the speaker from harm by day and night.

verse_text_en: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
verse_text_es:
El Señor te cuidará;
de todo mal guardará tu vida.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God commits to keep the psalmist from all evil and preserve his soul.

verse_text_en: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forth, and forevermore. A Song of Ascents. By David.
verse_text_es:
El Señor cuidará tu salida y tu entrada,
desde ahora y para siempre.
verse_text_bilingual:
Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forth, and forevermore. A Song of Ascents. By David.

El Señor cuidará tu salida y tu entrada,
desde ahora y para siempre.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to protect David's going out and coming in.

verse_text_en: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.
verse_text_es:
Pidan por la paz de Jerusalén:
«Que vivan en paz los que te aman.
verse_text_bilingual:
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

Pidan por la paz de Jerusalén:
«Que vivan en paz los que te aman.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to bless and protect those who love Jerusalem.

verse_text_en: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
verse_text_es:
Los que con lágrimas siembran,
con regocijo cosechan.
verse_text_bilingual:
Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

Los que con lágrimas siembran,
con regocijo cosechan.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises that those who sow in tears will reap in joy, indicating a future blessing.

verse_text_en: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves. A Song of Ascents. By Solomon.
verse_text_es:
El que llorando esparce la semilla,
cantando recoge sus gavillas.
verse_text_bilingual:
He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves. A Song of Ascents. By Solomon.

El que llorando esparce la semilla,
cantando recoge sus gavillas.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises that those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

verse_text_en: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
verse_text_es:
Lo que ganes con tus manos, eso comerás;
gozarás de dicha y prosperidad.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises a blessing of provision and well-being to those who follow him.

verse_text_en: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine, in the innermost parts of your house; your children like olive plants, around your table.
verse_text_es:
En el seno de tu hogar,
tu esposa será como vid llena de uvas;
alrededor de tu mesa,
tus hijos serán como vástagos de olivo.
verse_text_bilingual:
Your wife will be as a fruitful vine, in the innermost parts of your house; your children like olive plants, around your table.

En el seno de tu hogar,
tu esposa será como vid llena de uvas;
alrededor de tu mesa,
tus hijos serán como vástagos de olivo.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God describes the blessings of a faithful marriage and family.

verse_text_en: He will redeem Israel from all their sins. A Song of Ascents. By David.
verse_text_es:
Él mismo redimirá a Israel
de todos sus pecados.
verse_text_bilingual:
He will redeem Israel from all their sins. A Song of Ascents. By David.

Él mismo redimirá a Israel
de todos sus pecados.
promise_type_description: A divine commitment that does not fit the other categories.
why_promise: God's promise to redeem Israel from their sins, made by David.

verse_text_en: Yahweh has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: "I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
verse_text_es:
El Señor ha hecho a David
un firme juramento que no revocará:
«A uno de tus propios descendientes
lo pondré en tu trono.
verse_text_bilingual:
Yahweh has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: "I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.

El Señor ha hecho a David
un firme juramento que no revocará:
«A uno de tus propios descendientes
lo pondré en tu trono.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God's oath to David, committing to establish his dynasty.

verse_text_en: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forevermore."
verse_text_es:
Si tus hijos cumplen con mi pacto
y con los mandatos que les enseñaré,
también sus descendientes
te sucederán en el trono para siempre».
verse_text_bilingual:
If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forevermore."

Si tus hijos cumplen con mi pacto
y con los mandatos que les enseñaré,
también sus descendientes
te sucederán en el trono para siempre».
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God's promise to David about his descendants and their throne.
condition_clause: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forevermore

verse_text_en: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verse_text_es:
Bendeciré con creces sus provisiones,
y saciaré de pan a sus pobres.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.

Bendeciré con creces sus provisiones,
y saciaré de pan a sus pobres.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God's promise to provide for his people's needs.

verse_text_en: Her priests I will also clothe with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.
verse_text_es:
Revestiré de salvación a sus sacerdotes
y jubilosos cantarán sus fieles.
verse_text_bilingual:
Her priests I will also clothe with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.

Revestiré de salvación a sus sacerdotes
y jubilosos cantarán sus fieles.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to clothe the priests with salvation, indicating a protective and saving role.

verse_text_en: There I will make the horn of David to bud. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
verse_text_es:
»Aquí haré renacer el poder de David
y encenderé la lámpara de mi ungido.
verse_text_bilingual:
There I will make the horn of David to bud. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.

»Aquí haré renacer el poder de David
y encenderé la lámpara de mi ungido.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to David's descendant (the Messiah) to protect and guide him.

verse_text_en: For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants.
verse_text_es:
Ciertamente el Señor juzgará a su pueblo
y de sus siervos tendrá compasión.
verse_text_bilingual:
For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants.

Ciertamente el Señor juzgará a su pueblo
y de sus siervos tendrá compasión.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God commits to judge and have compassion on his people.

verse_text_en: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
verse_text_es:
Oh Señor, todos los reyes de la tierra
te alabarán al escuchar tus palabras.
verse_text_bilingual:
All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.

Oh Señor, todos los reyes de la tierra
te alabarán al escuchar tus palabras.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's words are a source of protection and praise from kings of the earth.

verse_text_en: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch forth your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.
verse_text_es:
Aunque pase por grandes angustias,
tú me darás vida;
contra el furor de mis enemigos extenderás la mano:
¡tu mano derecha me pondrá a salvo!
verse_text_bilingual:
Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch forth your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.

Aunque pase por grandes angustias,
tú me darás vida;
contra el furor de mis enemigos extenderás la mano:
¡tu mano derecha me pondrá a salvo!
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to save the psalmist from his enemies.

verse_text_en: Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me; your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don't forsake the works of your own hands. For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.
verse_text_bilingual:
Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me; your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don't forsake the works of your own hands. For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

El Señor cumplirá en mí su propósito.
Tu gran amor, Señor, perdura para siempre;
¡no abandones la obra de tus manos!
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's loving kindness and faithfulness are a promise to David.

verse_text_en: Even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
verse_text_es:
aun allí tu mano me guiaría,
¡me sostendría tu mano derecha!
verse_text_bilingual:
Even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.

aun allí tu mano me guiaría,
¡me sostendría tu mano derecha!
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's guidance is described as leading and holding, indicating a sense of direction and support.

verse_text_en: I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
verse_text_es:
Yo sé que el Señor hace justicia al pobre
y defiende el derecho de los necesitados.
verse_text_bilingual:
I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

Yo sé que el Señor hace justicia al pobre
y defiende el derecho de los necesitados.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's commitment to maintain the cause of the afflicted and justice for the needy.

verse_text_en: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me. A Psalm by David.
verse_text_es:
Sácame de la prisión,
para que alabe yo tu nombre.
Los justos se reunirán en torno mío
por la bondad que me has mostrado.
verse_text_bilingual:
Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me. A Psalm by David.

Sácame de la prisión,
para que alabe yo tu nombre.
Los justos se reunirán en torno mío
por la bondad que me has mostrado.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's goodness and presence are a promise of protection and care for the psalmist.

verse_text_en: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
verse_text_es:
Enséñame a hacer tu voluntad,
porque tú eres mi Dios.
Que tu buen Espíritu me guíe
por un terreno firme.
verse_text_bilingual:
Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.

Enséñame a hacer tu voluntad,
porque tú eres mi Dios.
Que tu buen Espíritu me guíe
por un terreno firme.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's Spirit is described as 'good' and is asked to lead the psalmist in the right path.

verse_text_en: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.
verse_text_es:

verse_text_en: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

el monte del Templo del Señor será establecido
como el más alto de los montes;
se alzará por encima de las colinas
y hacia él correrán todas las naciones.

verse_text_en: Many peoples shall go and say, "Come, let's go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths." For out of Zion the law shall go forth, and the word of Yahweh from Jerusalem.

Muchos pueblos vendrán y dirán:
«¡Vengan, subamos al monte del Señor,
al Templo del Dios de Jacob!
Dios mismo nos instruirá en sus caminos
y así andaremos por sus sendas».
Porque de Sión saldrá la Ley,
de Jerusalén, la palabra del Señor.

verse_text_en: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

y administrará justicia a muchos pueblos.
Convertirán sus espadas en arados
y en hoces sus lanzas.
Ya no levantará su espada nación contra nación
y nunca más se adiestrarán para la guerra.
