verse_text_es:
Porque el Señor, el Señor de los Ejércitos,
ejecutará la destrucción decretada contra todo el país.
verse_text_bilingual:
For the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, in the midst of all the earth.

Porque el Señor, el Señor de los Ejércitos,
ejecutará la destrucción decretada contra todo el país.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God commits to bring a full end to evil and destruction.

verse_text_en: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, says "My people who dwell in Zion, don't be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Egypt did.
verse_text_es:
Por eso, así dice el Señor, el Señor de los Ejércitos:
«Pueblo mío que vives en Sión,
no tengas temor de Asiria,
aunque te golpee con el bastón
y contra ti levante una vara, como lo hizo Egipto.
verse_text_bilingual:
Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, says "My people who dwell in Zion, don't be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Egypt did.

Por eso, así dice el Señor, el Señor de los Ejércitos:
«Pueblo mío que vives en Sión,
no tengas temor de Asiria,
aunque te golpee con el bastón
y contra ti levante una vara, como lo hizo Egipto.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God assures his people of his protection against the Assyrian threat.

verse_text_en: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction."
verse_text_es:
Dentro de muy poco tiempo
mi indignación contra ti llegará a su fin y mi ira destruirá a tus enemigos».
verse_text_bilingual:
For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction."

Dentro de muy poco tiempo
mi indignación contra ti llegará a su fin y mi ira destruirá a tus enemigos».
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's anger will be directed to the destruction of the enemy, indicating protection for the righteous.

verse_text_en: It will happen in that day, that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.
verse_text_es:
En aquel día
esa carga se te quitará de los hombros
y, a causa de la gordura,
se romperá el yugo que llevas en el cuello.
verse_text_bilingual:
It will happen in that day, that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.

En aquel día
esa carga se te quitará de los hombros
y, a causa de la gordura,
se romperá el yugo que llevas en el cuello.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to deliver Israel from oppression and destruction.

verse_text_en: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.
verse_text_es:
Del tronco de Isaí brotará un retoño;
un renuevo nacerá de sus raíces.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises a future deliverer and restoration through the descendant of Jesse.

verse_text_en: The Spirit of Yahweh will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahweh.
verse_text_es:
El Espíritu del Señor reposará sobre él:
Espíritu de sabiduría y de entendimiento,
Espíritu de consejo y de poder,
Espíritu de conocimiento y de temor del Señor.
verse_text_bilingual:
The Spirit of Yahweh will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahweh.

El Espíritu del Señor reposará sobre él:
Espíritu de sabiduría y de entendimiento,
Espíritu de consejo y de poder,
Espíritu de conocimiento y de temor del Señor.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God gives the Spirit of wisdom and understanding to the Messiah.

verse_text_en: His delight will be in the fear of Yahweh. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears;
verse_text_es:
Él se deleitará en el temor del Señor.
No juzgará según las apariencias
ni decidirá por lo que oiga decir,
verse_text_bilingual:
His delight will be in the fear of Yahweh. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears;

Él se deleitará en el temor del Señor.
No juzgará según las apariencias
ni decidirá por lo que oiga decir,
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God describes the heart of the righteous, promising a new way of living guided by God's Spirit.

verse_text_en: but with righteousness he will judge the poor, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked.
verse_text_es:
sino que juzgará con justicia a los necesitados,
y dará un fallo justo en favor de los pobres de la tierra.
Herirá la tierra con la vara de su boca;
matará al malvado con el aliento de sus labios.
verse_text_bilingual:
but with righteousness he will judge the poor, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked.

sino que juzgará con justicia a los necesitados,
y dará un fallo justo en favor de los pobres de la tierra.
Herirá la tierra con la vara de su boca;
matará al malvado con el aliento de sus labios.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's judgment and justice will be guided by righteousness and equity.

verse_text_en: Righteousness will be the belt of his waist, and faithfulness the belt of his waist.
verse_text_es:
La justicia será el cinto de sus lomos
y la fidelidad, el ceñidor de su cintura.
verse_text_bilingual:
Righteousness will be the belt of his waist, and faithfulness the belt of his waist.

La justicia será el cinto de sus lomos
y la fidelidad, el ceñidor de su cintura.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God describes the righteousness and faithfulness of the Messiah as a protective belt.

verse_text_en: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat; The calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them.
verse_text_es:
El lobo vivirá con el cordero,
el leopardo se echará con el cabrito,
juntos andarán el ternero y el cachorro de león
y un niño pequeño los guiará.
verse_text_bilingual:
The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat; The calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them.

El lobo vivirá con el cordero,
el leopardo se echará con el cabrito,
juntos andarán el ternero y el cachorro de león
y un niño pequeño los guiará.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God describes a future state where predators and prey coexist peacefully, implying his protection and care for creation.

verse_text_en: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.
verse_text_es:
La vaca pastará con la osa,
sus crías se echarán juntas
y el león comerá paja como el buey.
verse_text_bilingual:
The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.

La vaca pastará con la osa,
sus crías se echarán juntas
y el león comerá paja como el buey.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises a future time of peace and harmony among animals.

verse_text_en: The nursing child will play near a cobra's hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper's den.
verse_text_es:
Jugará el niño de pecho junto a la cueva de la cobra
y el recién destetado meterá la mano en el nido de la víbora.
verse_text_bilingual:
The nursing child will play near a cobra's hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper's den.

Jugará el niño de pecho junto a la cueva de la cobra
y el recién destetado meterá la mano en el nido de la víbora.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect even the most vulnerable, including children, from harm.

verse_text_en: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of Yahweh, as the waters cover the sea.
verse_text_es:
No harán ningún daño ni estrago
en todo mi monte santo,
porque se llenará la tierra con el conocimiento del Señor
así como las aguas cubren los mares.
verse_text_bilingual:
They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of Yahweh, as the waters cover the sea.

No harán ningún daño ni estrago
en todo mi monte santo,
porque se llenará la tierra con el conocimiento del Señor
así como las aguas cubren los mares.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to preserve his people and the earth from harm.

verse_text_en: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.
verse_text_es: En aquel día se alzará la raíz de Isaí como bandera de los pueblos; hacia él correrán las naciones, y glorioso será el lugar donde repose.
verse_text_bilingual:
It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.

En aquel día se alzará la raíz de Isaí como bandera de los pueblos; hacia él correrán las naciones, y glorioso será el lugar donde repose.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God promises to guide and bless those who seek the Messiah, Jesus, through the root of Jesse (Jesus Christ).

verse_text_en: It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
verse_text_es: En aquel día el Señor volverá a extender su mano para recuperar al remanente de su pueblo, a los que hayan quedado en Asiria, en Egipto, Patros y Cus; en Elam, Sinar, Jamat y en las islas del Mediterráneo.
verse_text_bilingual:
It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

En aquel día el Señor volverá a extender su mano para recuperar al remanente de su pueblo, a los que hayan quedado en Asiria, en Egipto, Patros y Cus; en Elam, Sinar, Jamat y en las islas del Mediterráneo.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to recover his people from various nations, indicating a promise of restoration and redemption.

verse_text_en: He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
verse_text_es:
Izará una bandera para las naciones,
reunirá a los desterrados de Israel
y de los cuatro puntos cardinales
juntará al pueblo esparcido de Judá.
verse_text_bilingual:
He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

Izará una bandera para las naciones,
reunirá a los desterrados de Israel
y de los cuatro puntos cardinales
juntará al pueblo esparcido de Judá.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God's promise to restore and reunite Israel and Judah.

verse_text_en: The envy also of Ephraim will depart, and those who persecute Judah will be cut off. Ephraim won't envy Judah, and Judah won't persecute Ephraim.
verse_text_es:
Desaparecerán los celos de Efraín;
los opresores de Judá serán aniquilados.
Efraín no tendrá más celos de Judá
ni oprimirá Judá a Efraín.
verse_text_bilingual:
The envy also of Ephraim will depart, and those who persecute Judah will be cut off. Ephraim won't envy Judah, and Judah won't persecute Ephraim.

Desaparecerán los celos de Efraín;
los opresores de Judá serán aniquilados.
Efraín no tendrá más celos de Judá
ni oprimirá Judá a Efraín.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God makes a promise of unity and peace between Ephraim and Judah.

verse_text_en: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them.
verse_text_es:
Juntos se lanzarán hacia el oeste contra las laderas de los filisteos;
juntos saquearán a los pueblos del este,
dejarán sentir su poder sobre Edom y Moab
y se les someterán los amonitas.
verse_text_bilingual:
They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them.

Juntos se lanzarán hacia el oeste contra las laderas de los filisteos;
juntos saquearán a los pueblos del este,
dejarán sentir su poder sobre Edom y Moab
y se les someterán los amonitas.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises to extend Israel's power and influence over surrounding nations.

verse_text_en: There will be a highway for the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, like there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
verse_text_es:
Para el remanente de su pueblo,
para los que hayan quedado en Asiria,
habrá un camino, como lo hubo para Israel
cuando salió de Egipto.
verse_text_bilingual:
There will be a highway for the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, like there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.

Para el remanente de su pueblo,
para los que hayan quedado en Asiria,
habrá un camino, como lo hubo para Israel
cuando salió de Egipto.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises a highway for the remnant of his people, referencing the Exodus from Egypt.

verse_text_en: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.
verse_text_es:
Con alegría sacarán ustedes agua
de las fuentes de la salvación.
verse_text_bilingual:
Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.

Con alegría sacarán ustedes agua
de las fuentes de la salvación.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God assures his people that they will find salvation and refreshment.

verse_text_en: I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.
verse_text_es:
Voy a hacer que haya menos gente que oro fino,
menos mortales que oro de Ofir.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.

Voy a hacer que haya menos gente que oro fino,
menos mortales que oro de Ofir.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises to make people scarce and valuable like precious metals.

verse_text_en: Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans' pride, will be like when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
verse_text_es:
Babilonia, la perla de los reinos,
la gloria y el orgullo de los babilonios,
quedará como Sodoma y Gomorra
cuando Dios las destruyó.
verse_text_bilingual:
Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans' pride, will be like when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

Babilonia, la perla de los reinos,
la gloria y el orgullo de los babilonios,
quedará como Sodoma y Gomorra
cuando Dios las destruyó.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's judgment on Babylon is compared to his judgment on Sodom and Gomorrah, indicating a promise of God's justice and righteousness.

verse_text_en: For Yahweh will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.
verse_text_es:
En verdad, el Señor tendrá compasión de Jacob
y elegirá de nuevo a Israel.
Los asentará en su propio lugar.
Los extranjeros se juntarán con ellos
y se unirán a los descendientes de Jacob.
verse_text_bilingual:
For Yahweh will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.

En verdad, el Señor tendrá compasión de Jacob
y elegirá de nuevo a Israel.
Los asentará en su propio lugar.
Los extranjeros se juntarán con ellos
y se unirán a los descendientes de Jacob.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God's promise to choose and bless Israel, and to include the foreigner in their number.

verse_text_en: It will happen in the day that Yahweh will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,
verse_text_es: Cuando el Señor te haga descansar de tu sufrimiento, de tu tormento y de la cruel esclavitud a la que fuiste sometido,
verse_text_bilingual:
It will happen in the day that Yahweh will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,

Cuando el Señor te haga descansar de tu sufrimiento, de tu tormento y de la cruel esclavitud a la que fuiste sometido,
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to give rest and relief from suffering.

verse_text_en: Yahweh of Armies has sworn, saying, "Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
verse_text_bilingual:
Yahweh of Armies has sworn, saying, "Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

El Señor de los Ejércitos ha jurado:
«Tal como lo he planeado, se cumplirá;
tal como lo he decidido, se realizará.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God makes a solemn oath, committing to fulfill his plans and purposes.

verse_text_en: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God commits to deliver Israel from Assyrian oppression.

verse_text_en: A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.
verse_text_es:
El trono se fundará en el amor
y uno de la casa de David
reinará sobre él con fidelidad:
será un juez celoso del derecho
y experto en hacer justicia.
verse_text_bilingual:
A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.

El trono se fundará en el amor
y uno de la casa de David
reinará sobre él con fidelidad:
será un juez celoso del derecho
y experto en hacer justicia.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to establish a throne in loving kindness and truth, associated with the tent of David.

verse_text_en: The fortress shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria. They will be as the glory of the children of Israel," says Yahweh of Armies.
verse_text_es:
Efraín perderá la ciudad fortificada;
Damasco se quedará sin realeza.
El remanente de Aram
será como la gloria de los israelitas»,
afirma el Señor de los Ejércitos.
verse_text_bilingual:
The fortress shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria. They will be as the glory of the children of Israel," says Yahweh of Armies.

Efraín perderá la ciudad fortificada;
Damasco se quedará sin realeza.
El remanente de Aram
será como la gloria de los israelitas»,
afirma el Señor de los Ejércitos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect and restore Israel's glory.

verse_text_en: Yet gleanings will be left there, like the shaking of an olive tree, two or three olives in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outermost branches of a fruitful tree," says Yahweh, the God of Israel.
verse_text_es:
Pero quedarán algunas uvas,
como cuando se golpea el olivo
y dos o tres aceitunas se quedan en las ramas más altas,
y tal vez cuatro o cinco en todas las ramas del árbol»,
afirma el Señor, el Dios de Israel.
verse_text_bilingual:
Yet gleanings will be left there, like the shaking of an olive tree, two or three olives in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outermost branches of a fruitful tree," says Yahweh, the God of Israel.

Pero quedarán algunas uvas,
como cuando se golpea el olivo
y dos o tres aceitunas se quedan en las ramas más altas,
y tal vez cuatro o cinco en todas las ramas del árbol»,
afirma el Señor, el Dios de Israel.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God assures Israel of future abundance and provision.

verse_text_en: In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.
verse_text_es:
En aquel día buscará el pueblo a su Hacedor;
fijará la mirada en el Santo de Israel.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's people will look to Him for protection and respect Him as the Holy One.

verse_text_en: I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them," says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.
verse_text_es:
Entregaré a los egipcios
en manos de un amo cruel;
un rey de mano dura los gobernará»,
afirma el Señor, el Señor de los Ejércitos.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them," says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

Entregaré a los egipcios
en manos de un amo cruel;
un rey de mano dura los gobernará»,
afirma el Señor, el Señor de los Ejércitos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God commits to deliver the Egyptians from their oppressors.

verse_text_en: In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to Yahweh of Armies. One will be called "The city of destruction."
verse_text_es: En aquel día habrá en Egipto cinco ciudades que hablarán el idioma de Canaán y que jurarán lealtad al Señor de los Ejércitos. Una de ellas se llamará Ciudad del Sol.
verse_text_bilingual:
In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to Yahweh of Armies. One will be called "The city of destruction."

En aquel día habrá en Egipto cinco ciudades que hablarán el idioma de Canaán y que jurarán lealtad al Señor de los Ejércitos. Una de ellas se llamará Ciudad del Sol.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to establish a covenant with Egypt, where people will swear to Yahweh.

verse_text_en: In that day, there will be an altar to Yahweh in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to Yahweh at its border.
verse_text_es: En aquel día habrá un altar para el Señor en el corazón mismo de Egipto y en su frontera un monumento al Señor.
verse_text_bilingual:
In that day, there will be an altar to Yahweh in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to Yahweh at its border.

En aquel día habrá un altar para el Señor en el corazón mismo de Egipto y en su frontera un monumento al Señor.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God establishes a covenant with Egypt, promising a future altar and pillar.

verse_text_en: It will be for a sign and for a witness to Yahweh of Armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to Yahweh because of oppressors, and he will send them a savior and a defender, and he will deliver them.
verse_text_es: Esto servirá en Egipto de señal y testimonio del Señor de los Ejércitos. Cuando ellos clamen al Señor por causa de sus opresores, él les enviará un salvador y defensor que los librará.
verse_text_bilingual:
It will be for a sign and for a witness to Yahweh of Armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to Yahweh because of oppressors, and he will send them a savior and a defender, and he will deliver them.

Esto servirá en Egipto de señal y testimonio del Señor de los Ejércitos. Cuando ellos clamen al Señor por causa de sus opresores, él les enviará un salvador y defensor que los librará.
promise_type_description: God rescues His people from bondage, danger or judgment.
why_promise: God promises to send a savior and defender to Egypt, and deliver them from oppressors.

verse_text_en: Yahweh will strike Egypt, striking and healing. They will return to Yahweh, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.
verse_text_es: El Señor herirá a los egipcios con una plaga y, aun hiriéndolos, los sanará. Ellos se volverán al Señor, y él responderá a sus ruegos y los sanará.
verse_text_bilingual:
Yahweh will strike Egypt, striking and healing. They will return to Yahweh, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.

El Señor herirá a los egipcios con una plaga y, aun hiriéndolos, los sanará. Ellos se volverán al Señor, y él responderá a sus ruegos y los sanará.
promise_type_description: God restores health or makes whole what is broken.
why_promise: God promises to strike and heal Egypt, and to be entreated and heal those who return to him.

verse_text_en: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.
verse_text_es: En aquel día habrá un camino desde Egipto hasta Asiria. Los asirios irán a Egipto y los egipcios a Asiria, y unos y otros adorarán juntos.
verse_text_bilingual:
In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.

En aquel día habrá un camino desde Egipto hasta Asiria. Los asirios irán a Egipto y los egipcios a Asiria, y unos y otros adorarán juntos.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to a future time when Egypt and Assyria will worship together, indicating a future alliance.

verse_text_en: In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth;
verse_text_es: En aquel día Israel será, junto con Egipto y Asiria, una bendición en medio de la tierra.
verse_text_bilingual:
In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth;

En aquel día Israel será, junto con Egipto y Asiria, una bendición en medio de la tierra.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God promises a blessing to Israel among the nations.

verse_text_en: For the Lord said to me, "Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,
verse_text_es: Porque así me dijo el Señor: «Dentro de un año, contado como lo cuenta un jornalero, toda la magnificencia de Cedar llegará a su fin.
verse_text_bilingual:
For the Lord said to me, "Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,

Porque así me dijo el Señor: «Dentro de un año, contado como lo cuenta un jornalero, toda la magnificencia de Cedar llegará a su fin.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's statement about the downfall of Kedar's glory is a promise of protection and judgment.

verse_text_en: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, has spoken it."
verse_text_es: Pocos serán los arqueros, los guerreros de Cedar, que sobrevivan». Lo ha dicho el Señor, el Dios de Israel.

and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, has spoken it."

promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God speaks of his protection and preservation of the people of Israel.

verse_text_en: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.
verse_text_es:
Te destituiré de tu cargo
y serás expulsado de tu puesto.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.

Te destituiré de tu cargo
y serás expulsado de tu puesto.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's action to remove a king from his position, implying protection from a greater threat.

verse_text_en: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,
verse_text_es: »En aquel día llamaré a mi siervo Eliaquín, hijo de Jilquías.
verse_text_bilingual:
It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,

»En aquel día llamaré a mi siervo Eliaquín, hijo de Jilquías.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God calls Eliakim, indicating a new role or appointment.

verse_text_en: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
verse_text_es: Le pondré tu túnica, le colocaré tu faja y le daré tu autoridad. Será como un padre para los habitantes de Jerusalén y para la tribu de Judá.
verse_text_bilingual:
and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

Le pondré tu túnica, le colocaré tu faja y le daré tu autoridad. Será como un padre para los habitantes de Jerusalén y para la tribu de Judá.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to anoint a future king and give him authority over Judah and Jerusalem.

verse_text_en: I will lay the key of the house of David on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.
verse_text_es: Sobre sus hombros pondré la llave de la casa de David; lo que él abra, nadie podrá cerrarlo; lo que él cierre, nadie podrá abrirlo.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will lay the key of the house of David on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.

Sobre sus hombros pondré la llave de la casa de David; lo que él abra, nadie podrá cerrarlo; lo que él cierre, nadie podrá abrirlo.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to establish a new ruler over Israel and secure their access to God's presence.

verse_text_en: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father's house.
verse_text_es: Como a una estaca, lo clavaré en un lugar firme y será como un trono de honor para la descendencia de su padre.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father's house.

Como a una estaca, lo clavaré en un lugar firme y será como un trono de honor para la descendencia de su padre.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to establish Hezekiah as a future king of Judah.

verse_text_en: It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute.
verse_text_es: En aquel tiempo Tiro será olvidada durante setenta años, que es lo que vive un rey. Pero al cabo de esos setenta años sucederá a Tiro lo que dice la canción de la prostituta:
verse_text_bilingual:
It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute.

En aquel tiempo Tiro será olvidada durante setenta años, que es lo que vive un rey. Pero al cabo de esos setenta años sucederá a Tiro lo que dice la canción de la prostituta:
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God commits to Tyre being forgotten for 70 years, which is a form of protection.

verse_text_en: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to Yahweh. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before Yahweh, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
verse_text_es: Pero sus ingresos y ganancias se consagrarán al Señor; no serán almacenados ni atesorados. Sus ganancias serán para los que habitan en presencia del Señor, para que se alimenten en abundancia y se vistan con ropas finas.
verse_text_bilingual:
Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to Yahweh. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before Yahweh, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

Pero sus ingresos y ganancias se consagrarán al Señor; no serán almacenados ni atesorados. Sus ganancias serán para los que habitan en presencia del Señor, para que se alimenten en abundancia y se vistan con ropas finas.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God's blessing on Tyre's merchandise and wages, to be used for the benefit of God's people.

verse_text_en: Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.
verse_text_es:
Por eso te glorifica un pueblo poderoso;
te honrarán las ciudades de las naciones violentas.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect and defend his people.

verse_text_en: In this mountain, Yahweh of Armies will make all peoples a feast of fat things, a feast of choice wines, of fat things full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.
verse_text_es:
Sobre este monte el Señor de los Ejércitos
preparará para todos los pueblos
un banquete de manjares especiales.
Un banquete de vinos añejos,
las mejores carnes y vinos selectos.
verse_text_bilingual:
In this mountain, Yahweh of Armies will make all peoples a feast of fat things, a feast of choice wines, of fat things full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.

Sobre este monte el Señor de los Ejércitos
preparará para todos los pueblos
un banquete de manjares especiales.
Un banquete de vinos añejos,
las mejores carnes y vinos selectos.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises to provide for all nations in the future, described as a feast of abundance.

verse_text_en: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.
verse_text_es:
Sobre este monte rasgará
el velo que cubre a todos los pueblos,
el manto que envuelve a todas las naciones.
verse_text_bilingual:
He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.

Sobre este monte rasgará
el velo que cubre a todos los pueblos,
el manto que envuelve a todas las naciones.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to destroy the veil that covers all nations, symbolizing salvation and redemption.

verse_text_en: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord Yahweh will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for Yahweh has spoken it.
verse_text_es:
Devorará a la muerte para siempre.
El Señor y Dios enjugará las lágrimas
de todo rostro
y quitará de toda la tierra
la deshonra de su pueblo.
El Señor mismo lo ha dicho.
verse_text_bilingual:
He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord Yahweh will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for Yahweh has spoken it.

Devorará a la muerte para siempre.
El Señor y Dios enjugará las lágrimas
de todo rostro
y quitará de toda la tierra
la deshonra de su pueblo.
El Señor mismo lo ha dicho.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to wipe away tears and take away reproach, indicating a promise of comfort and deliverance.

verse_text_en: It shall be said in that day, "Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is Yahweh! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!"
promise_type_description: God saves His people from sin and gives eternal life.
why_promise: God's salvation is a promise made to his people, expressed in the verse itself.

verse_text_en: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: "We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.
verse_text_es:
En aquel día se entonará esta canción en la tierra de Judá:
«Tenemos una ciudad fuerte.
Para salvarla,
Dios levantó muros y baluartes.
verse_text_bilingual:
In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: "We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.

En aquel día se entonará esta canción en la tierra de Judá:
«Tenemos una ciudad fuerte.
Para salvarla,
Dios levantó muros y baluartes.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to appoint salvation for the walls and bulwarks of Judah.

verse_text_en: You will keep whoever's mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
verse_text_es:
Al de carácter firme
lo guardarás en perfecta paz,
porque en ti confía.
verse_text_bilingual:
You will keep whoever's mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

Al de carácter firme
lo guardarás en perfecta paz,
porque en ti confía.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to keep those who trust in him in perfect peace.

verse_text_en: With my soul have I desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me will I seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
verse_text_es:
Todo mi ser te desea por las noches;
por la mañana mi espíritu te busca.
Pues, cuando tus juicios llegan a la tierra,
los habitantes del mundo aprenden lo que es justicia.
verse_text_bilingual:
With my soul have I desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me will I seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

Todo mi ser te desea por las noches;
por la mañana mi espíritu te busca.
Pues, cuando tus juicios llegan a la tierra,
los habitantes del mundo aprenden lo que es justicia.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's desire and pursuit of his people, indicating a personal and intimate relationship.

verse_text_en: Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also worked all our works for us.
verse_text_es:
Señor, tú estableces la paz en favor nuestro,
porque tú eres quien realiza todas nuestras obras.
verse_text_bilingual:
Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also worked all our works for us.

Señor, tú estableces la paz en favor nuestro,
porque tú eres quien realiza todas nuestras obras.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to ordain peace for his people.

verse_text_en: Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but by you only will we make mention of your name.
verse_text_es:
Señor y Dios nuestro,
otros señores nos han gobernado,
pero solo a tu nombre damos honra.
verse_text_bilingual:
Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but by you only will we make mention of your name.

Señor y Dios nuestro,
otros señores nos han gobernado,
pero solo a tu nombre damos honra.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to be the only true God worshipped by his people.

verse_text_en: Your dead shall live. My dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast forth the dead.
verse_text_es:
Pero tus muertos vivirán;
sus cadáveres volverán a la vida.
¡Despierten y griten de alegría,
moradores del polvo!
Porque tu rocío es como el rocío de la mañana
y la tierra devolverá sus muertos.
verse_text_bilingual:
Your dead shall live. My dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast forth the dead.

Pero tus muertos vivirán;
sus cadáveres volverán a la vida.
¡Despierten y griten de alegría,
moradores del polvo!
Porque tu rocío es como el rocío de la mañana
y la tierra devolverá sus muertos.
promise_type_description: God rescues His people from bondage, danger or judgment.
why_promise: God promises to raise the dead and restore life to the deceased.

verse_text_en: I, Yahweh, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.
verse_text_es:
Yo, el Señor, soy su guardián;
todo el tiempo riego mi viña.
Día y noche cuido de ella
para que nadie le haga daño.
verse_text_bilingual:

Día y noche cuido de ella
para que nadie le haga daño.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's commitment to protect and care for the vineyard, symbolizing Israel.

verse_text_en: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.
verse_text_es:
Días vendrán en que Jacob echará raíces,
en que Israel retoñará, florecerá
y llenará el mundo con sus frutos.
verse_text_bilingual:
In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.

Días vendrán en que Jacob echará raíces,
en que Israel retoñará, florecerá
y llenará el mundo con sus frutos.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God's promise of Israel's future prosperity and abundance.

verse_text_en: It will happen in that day, that Yahweh will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.
verse_text_es: En aquel día el Señor trillará desde las corrientes del Éufrates hasta el torrente de Egipto y ustedes, israelitas, serán recogidos uno por uno.
verse_text_bilingual:
It will happen in that day, that Yahweh will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.

En aquel día el Señor trillará desde las corrientes del Éufrates hasta el torrente de Egipto y ustedes, israelitas, serán recogidos uno por uno.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's judgment and gathering of Israel is described, indicating a promise of protection and restoration.

verse_text_en: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, shall come; and they will worship Yahweh in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.
verse_text_es: En aquel día sonará una gran trompeta. Los que fueron llevados a Asiria y los que fueron desterrados a Egipto vendrán y adorarán al Señor sobre el monte santo en Jerusalén.
verse_text_bilingual:
It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, shall come; and they will worship Yahweh in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.

En aquel día sonará una gran trompeta. Los que fueron llevados a Asiria y los que fueron desterrados a Egipto vendrán y adorarán al Señor sobre el monte santo en Jerusalén.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect and bring the exiled to the holy mountain at Jerusalem.

verse_text_en: In that day, Yahweh of Armies will become a crown of glory, and a diadem of beauty, to the residue of his people;
verse_text_es:
En aquel día el Señor de los Ejércitos
será una hermosa corona,
una diadema gloriosa
para el remanente de su pueblo.
verse_text_bilingual:
In that day, Yahweh of Armies will become a crown of glory, and a diadem of beauty, to the residue of his people;

En aquel día el Señor de los Ejércitos
será una hermosa corona,
una diadema gloriosa
para el remanente de su pueblo.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God promises to be a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to his people in the future.

verse_text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh, "Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.
verse_text_es:
Por eso dice el Señor y Dios:
«Miren, yo pongo en Sión una piedra probada,
piedra angular y preciosa para un cimiento firme;
el que crea no se tambaleará.
verse_text_bilingual:
Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh, "Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.

Por eso dice el Señor y Dios:
«Miren, yo pongo en Sión una piedra probada,
piedra angular y preciosa para un cimiento firme;
el que crea no se tambaleará.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God promises to lay a sure foundation in Zion, and those who believe in Him will not act hastily.

verse_text_en: I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.
verse_text_es:
Pondré como nivel la justicia
y la rectitud como plomada.
El granizo arrasará con el refugio de la mentira
y las aguas inundarán el escondite.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.

Pondré como nivel la justicia
y la rectitud como plomada.
El granizo arrasará con el refugio de la mentira
y las aguas inundarán el escondite.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to make justice and righteousness the guiding principles, protecting his people from deceit and evil.

verse_text_en: Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.
verse_text_es:
Se anulará el convenio que hicieron con la muerte;
quedará sin efecto su alianza con el sepulcro.
Cuando venga la calamidad abrumadora,
a ustedes los aplastará.
verse_text_bilingual:
Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.

Se anulará el convenio que hicieron con la muerte;
quedará sin efecto su alianza con el sepulcro.
Cuando venga la calamidad abrumadora,
a ustedes los aplastará.
promise_type_description: God rescues His people from bondage, danger or judgment.
why_promise: God commits to annul the covenant with death and Sheol, promising deliverance from the overflowing scourge.

verse_text_en: I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you.

Acamparé contra ti, te rodearé;
te cercaré con empalizadas
y levantaré contra ti torres de asedio.
promise_type_description: God rescues His people from bondage, danger or judgment.
why_promise: God commits to encamp against the people, implying a promise of deliverance or judgment.

verse_text_en: She will be visited by Yahweh of Armies with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.
promise_type_description: God rescues His people from bondage, danger or judgment.
why_promise: This verse describes God's judgment and visitation, which implies a promise of deliverance or action taken by God.

verse_text_en: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.
verse_text_es:
La multitud de todas las naciones que batallan contra Ariel,
todos los que luchan contra ella y contra su fortaleza,
aquellos que la asedian, serán como un sueño,
como una visión nocturna.
verse_text_bilingual:
The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.

La multitud de todas las naciones que batallan contra Ariel,
todos los que luchan contra ella y contra su fortaleza,
aquellos que la asedian, serán como un sueño,
como una visión nocturna.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect and defend Jerusalem (Ariel) from her enemies.

verse_text_en: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.
verse_text_es:
En aquel día podrán los sordos oír la lectura del rollo,
y los ojos de los ciegos podrán ver
sin tinieblas ni oscuridad.
verse_text_bilingual:
In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.

En aquel día podrán los sordos oír la lectura del rollo,
y los ojos de los ciegos podrán ver
sin tinieblas ni oscuridad.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to give the deaf and blind spiritual insight and understanding.

verse_text_en: The humble also will increase their joy in Yahweh, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
verse_text_es:
Los pobres volverán a alegrarse en el Señor;
los más necesitados se regocijarán en el Santo de Israel.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises that the humble and poor will experience joy and rejoice in Him.

verse_text_en: Therefore thus says Yahweh, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob: "Jacob shall no longer be ashamed, neither shall his face grow pale.
verse_text_es:
Por eso, el Señor, el redentor de Abraham, dice así a los descendientes de Jacob:
«Jacob ya no será avergonzado
ni palidecerá su rostro.
verse_text_bilingual:
Therefore thus says Yahweh, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob: "Jacob shall no longer be ashamed, neither shall his face grow pale.

Por cuanto el Señor y Dios me ayuda,
no seré humillado.
Por eso endurecí mi rostro como el pedernal
y sé que no seré avergonzado.

Cercano está el que me justifica;

¡Comparezcamos juntos!
¿Quién es mi acusador?
¡Que se me enfrente!

verse_text_en: For Yahweh has comforted Zion; he has comforted all her waste places, and has made her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of Yahweh; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

consolará todas sus ruinas.
Convertirá en un Edén su desierto;
en huerto del Señor sus tierras secas.

acción de gracias y música de salmos.

Las costas lejanas confían en mí

Levanten los ojos al cielo,

Pero mi salvación permanecerá para siempre,

Volverán los rescatados del Señor
y entrarán en Sión con cantos de júbilo;
su corona será el gozo eterno.
Se llenarán de regocijo y alegría,
y se apartarán de ellos el dolor y los quejidos.

No prevalecerá ninguna arma que se forje contra ti;

Esta es la herencia de los siervos del Señor,

En vez de madera te traeré bronce,

Haré que la paz te gobierne
y que la justicia te rija.

Ya no se sabrá de violencia en tu tierra

Ya no construirán casas para que otros las habiten

En todo mi monte santo
no habrá quien haga daño ni destruya»,

Fue mi mano la que hizo todas estas cosas;

a los que tiemblan ante mi palabra.

¿Podría yo abrir la matriz

dice el Señor.

»”No temas, Jacob, siervo mío;
no te asustes, Israel”,

y ya nadie te infundirá temor.

verse_text_en: For I am with you, says Yahweh, to save you: for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have scattered you, but I will not make a full end of you; but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.

Porque yo estoy contigo para salvarte”,
afirma el Señor.
“Destruiré por completo a todas las naciones
entre las que te había dispersado.
Pero a ti no te destruiré del todo,
sino que te disciplinaré con justicia;
de ninguna manera quedarás impune”.

verse_text_en: But don't you be afraid, Jacob my servant, neither be dismayed, Israel: for, behold, I will save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be quiet and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to protect and deliver Jacob and his seed from captivity.

verse_text_en: Don't you be afraid, O Jacob my servant, says Yahweh; for I am with you: for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have driven you; but I will not make a full end of you, but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.
verse_text_es:
Tú, Jacob, siervo mío, no temas,
porque yo estoy contigo»,
afirma el Señor.
«Aunque aniquile a todas las naciones
por las que te he dispersado,
a ti no te aniquilaré.
Te corregiré con justicia,
pero no te dejaré sin castigo».

verse_text_en: Yet will I bring back the captivity of Moab in the latter days, says Yahweh. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
verse_text_es:
»Pero en los días venideros
yo restauraré la fortuna de Moab»,
afirma el Señor.
Aquí concluye el juicio contra Moab.

verse_text_en: But afterward I will bring back the captivity of the children of Ammon, says Yahweh.
verse_text_es:

afirma el Señor.

verse_text_en: Leave your fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let your widows trust in me.

¡Abandona a tus huérfanos,
que yo les protegeré la vida!
¡Tus viudas pueden confiar en mí!».

promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to preserve and care for the fatherless and widows.

verse_text_en: For thus says Yahweh: Behold, they to whom it didn't pertain to drink of the cup shall certainly drink; and are you he who shall altogether go unpunished? You shall not go unpunished, but you shall surely drink.
verse_text_es: Así dice el Señor: «Los que no estaban condenados a beber la copa de castigo la bebieron. ¿Y acaso tú vas a quedarte sin castigo? ¡De ninguna manera quedarás impune, sino que también beberás de esa copa!

verse_text_en: As for your terror, the pride of your heart has deceived you, O you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, who hold the height of the hill: though you should make your nest as high as the eagle, I will bring you down from there, says Yahweh.
verse_text_es:
Tú, que habitas en las hendiduras de las rocas;
tú, que ocupas las alturas de los montes:
fuiste engañado por el terror que infundías
y por el orgullo de tu corazón.
Aunque pongas tu nido tan alto como el del águila,
desde allí te haré caer»,
afirma el Señor.

verse_text_en: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation: for I will suddenly make them run away from it; and whoever is chosen, him will I appoint over it: for who is like me? and who will appoint me a time? and who is the shepherd who will stand before me?
verse_text_es:
«Como león que sale de la espesura del Jordán
hacia praderas de verdes pastos,
en un instante espantaré de su tierra a los de Edom.
¿Quién es el elegido que nombraré para esto?
Porque, ¿quién como yo?
¿Quién me puede desafiar?
¿Qué pastor se me puede oponer?».

verse_text_en: Arise, go up to a nation that is at ease, that dwells without care, says Yahweh; that have neither gates nor bars, that dwell alone.
verse_text_es:
»¡Levántense y ataquen a esta nación indolente
que vive del todo confiada,
nación que no tiene puertas ni cerrojos
y que vive muy aislada!»,
afirma el Señor.

afirma el Señor.

verse_text_en: On Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of the sky, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation where the outcasts of Elam shall not come.
verse_text_es:
Voy a desatar contra Elam los cuatro vientos
desde los cuatro extremos del cielo.
Los voy a esparcir por los cuatro vientos,
y no quedará nación alguna
adonde no lleguen sus desterrados.

»En aquellos días, en aquel tiempo,
la gente de Israel y de Judá
irá llorando en busca del Señor su Dios»,
afirma el Señor.

«Preguntarán por el camino a Sión

Babilonia será saqueada,

promise_type_description: A divine commitment that does not fit the other categories.

verse_text_es:
Haré que Israel vuelva a su prado
y que se alimente en el Carmelo y en Basán.
Su apetito quedará saciado
en las montañas de Efraín y Galaad.

verse_text_en: In those days, and in that time, says Yahweh, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I leave as a remnant.
verse_text_es:
En aquellos días, en aquel tiempo, se buscará la iniquidad de Israel,
pero ya no se encontrará.
Buscarán los pecados de Judá,
pero ya no se hallarán,
porque yo perdonaré a los que deje como remanente»,
afirma el Señor.

Pero su Redentor es fuerte,
su nombre es el Señor de los Ejércitos.
Con vigor defenderá su causa;
traerá descanso a su tierra,
pero perturbación a Babilonia.

verse_text_en: I will send to Babylon strangers, who shall winnow her; and they shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her around.
verse_text_es:
Enviaré contra Babilonia extranjeros que la lancen por los aires,
que la aviente como se avienta el trigo, hasta dejarla vacía.
En el día de su calamidad
la atacarán por todas partes.

“Te llenaré de enemigos, como de langostas,
y lanzarán gritos de victoria sobre ti”.

verse_text_es:
»Tú eres mi mazo, mi arma de guerra;
contigo destrozo naciones y reinos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.

Contigo destrozo jinetes y caballos;
contigo destrozo carros de guerra y sus conductores.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.

verse_text_en: I will render to Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, says Yahweh.

promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to render judgment and protection to Zion, specifically against Babylon and its inhabitants.

verse_text_en: They shall not take of you a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but you shall be desolate for ever, says Yahweh.
verse_text_es:
No volverán a tomar de ti piedra angular,
ni piedra de cimiento,
porque para siempre quedarás desolada»,
afirma el Señor.

Por eso, así dice el Señor:

y llevaré a cabo tu venganza;

y dejaré secos sus manantiales.

Cuando entre en calor,

Entonces el cielo y la tierra,
