verse_text_en: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: I will spread out my net on you with a company of many peoples; and they shall bring you up in my net.
verse_text_es:
»”Así dice el Señor y Dios:
»” Aunque estés entre numerosos pueblos,
tenderé sobre ti mi red
y te atraparé con ella.
verse_text_bilingual:
Thus says the Lord Yahweh: I will spread out my net on you with a company of many peoples; and they shall bring you up in my net.

»”Así dice el Señor y Dios:
»” Aunque estés entre numerosos pueblos,
tenderé sobre ti mi red
y te atraparé con ella.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God himself commits to spreading out his net on Pharaoh, implying a protective action.

verse_text_en: I will leave you on the land, I will cast you forth on the open field, and will cause all the birds of the sky to settle on you, and I will satisfy the animals of the whole earth with you.
verse_text_es:
Te arrastraré por tierra
y en pleno campo te dejaré tendido.
Dejaré que sobre ti se posen
todas las aves del cielo.
Dejaré que con tu carne
se sacien todas las bestias de la tierra.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will leave you on the land, I will cast you forth on the open field, and will cause all the birds of the sky to settle on you, and I will satisfy the animals of the whole earth with you.

Te arrastraré por tierra
y en pleno campo te dejaré tendido.
Dejaré que sobre ti se posen
todas las aves del cielo.
Dejaré que con tu carne
se sacien todas las bestias de la tierra.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God's promise to leave the land to the Philistines and provide for them with the animals of the earth.

verse_text_en: I will also water with your blood the land in which you swim, even to the mountains; and the watercourses shall be full of you.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will also water with your blood the land in which you swim, even to the mountains; and the watercourses shall be full of you.

Con tu sangre empaparé la tierra
hasta la cima de las montañas;
con tu sangre llenaré los canales de los ríos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's judgment on Egypt, where the Israelites will be a plague and a curse.

verse_text_en: I will destroy also all its animals from beside many waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of animals trouble them.
verse_text_es:
Voy a destruir todo el ganado
que pasta junto a las aguas abundantes;
nunca más serán enturbiadas
por hombres ni animales.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will destroy also all its animals from beside many waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of animals trouble them.

Voy a destruir todo el ganado
que pasta junto a las aguas abundantes;
nunca más serán enturbiadas
por hombres ni animales.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to protect and deliver the land from human and animal threats.

verse_text_en: Then will I make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil, says the Lord Yahweh.
verse_text_es:
Entonces dejaré que las aguas se asienten
y que corran tranquilas, como el aceite,
afirma el Señor y Dios.
verse_text_bilingual:
Then will I make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil, says the Lord Yahweh.

Entonces dejaré que las aguas se asienten
y que corran tranquilas, como el aceite,
afirma el Señor y Dios.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God commits to making the waters clear and the rivers flow like oil, which is a provision for the people.

verse_text_en: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, says the Lord Yahweh.
verse_text_es: »El faraón los verá y se consolará de la muerte de toda su gente, pues él y todo su ejército morirán a filo de espada, afirma el Señor y Dios.
verse_text_bilingual:
Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, says the Lord Yahweh.

»El faraón los verá y se consolará de la muerte de toda su gente, pues él y todo su ejército morirán a filo de espada, afirma el Señor y Dios.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect Pharaoh and his army from death.

verse_text_en: But if the watchman sees the sword come, and doesn't blow the trumpet, and the people aren't warned, and the sword comes, and take any person from among them; he is taken away in his iniquity, but his blood will I require at the watchman's hand.
verse_text_es: Ahora bien, si el centinela ve venir la espada y no toca la trompeta para prevenir al pueblo, y viene la espada y mata a alguien, esa persona perecerá por su maldad, pero al centinela yo le pediré cuentas de esa muerte”.
verse_text_bilingual:
But if the watchman sees the sword come, and doesn't blow the trumpet, and the people aren't warned, and the sword comes, and take any person from among them; he is taken away in his iniquity, but his blood will I require at the watchman's hand.

Ahora bien, si el centinela ve venir la espada y no toca la trompeta para prevenir al pueblo, y viene la espada y mata a alguien, esa persona perecerá por su maldad, pero al centinela yo le pediré cuentas de esa muerte”.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God holds the watchman accountable for warning the people, and promises to require his blood if he fails.
condition_clause: if the watchman sees the sword come, and doesn't blow the trumpet, and the people aren't warned, and the sword comes, and take any person from among them

verse_text_en: Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he doesn't turn from his way; he shall die in his iniquity, but you have delivered your soul.
verse_text_es: En cambio, si tú adviertes al malvado que cambie su mala conducta y no lo hace, él morirá por causa de su pecado, pero tú habrás salvado tu vida.
verse_text_bilingual:
Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he doesn't turn from his way; he shall die in his iniquity, but you have delivered your soul.

En cambio, si tú adviertes al malvado que cambie su mala conducta y no lo hace, él morirá por causa de su pecado, pero tú habrás salvado tu vida.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God commits to deliver the soul of the prophet if he warns the wicked and they do not turn from their way.
condition_clause: if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he doesn't turn from his way

verse_text_en: Tell them, As I live, says the Lord Yahweh, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn, turn from your evil ways; for why will you die, house of Israel?
verse_text_es: Diles: “Tan cierto como que yo vivo, afirma el Señor y Dios, no me alegro con la muerte del malvado, sino con que se convierta de su mala conducta y viva. ¡Conviértete, pueblo de Israel; conviértete de tu conducta perversa! ¿Por qué habrás de morir?”.
verse_text_bilingual:
Tell them, As I live, says the Lord Yahweh, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn, turn from your evil ways; for why will you die, house of Israel?

Diles: “Tan cierto como que yo vivo, afirma el Señor y Dios, no me alegro con la muerte del malvado, sino con que se convierta de su mala conducta y viva. ¡Conviértete, pueblo de Israel; conviértete de tu conducta perversa! ¿Por qué habrás de morir?”.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to spare the wicked if they turn from their evil ways.

verse_text_en: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verse_text_es: y devuelve lo que tomó en prenda y restituye lo que robó, y obedece los estatutos de vida, sin cometer ninguna iniquidad, ciertamente vivirá y no morirá.
verse_text_bilingual:
if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.

y devuelve lo que tomó en prenda y restituye lo que robó, y obedece los estatutos de vida, sin cometer ninguna iniquidad, ciertamente vivirá y no morirá.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise of protection and life for the wicked who restores what they have taken by robbery.
condition_clause: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity

verse_text_en: None of his sins that he has committed shall be remembered against him: he has done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.
verse_text_es: No se tomarán en cuenta contra él todos los pecados que antes cometió y vivirá por haber actuado con justicia y rectitud”.
verse_text_bilingual:
None of his sins that he has committed shall be remembered against him: he has done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.

No se tomarán en cuenta contra él todos los pecados que antes cometió y vivirá por haber actuado con justicia y rectitud”.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to forgive and forget the sins of those who follow His laws.

verse_text_en: When the wicked turns from his wickedness, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.
verse_text_es: Y, si el malvado deja de hacer lo malo y actúa con justicia y rectitud, vivirá.
verse_text_bilingual:
When the wicked turns from his wickedness, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.

Y, si el malvado deja de hacer lo malo y actúa con justicia y rectitud, vivirá.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises that those who turn from their wickedness and live righteously will be protected and live.

verse_text_en: Therefore tell them, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood: and shall you possess the land?
verse_text_es: Por tanto, adviérteles que así dice el Señor y Dios: “Ustedes comen carne con sangre, adoran a sus ídolos y derraman sangre, ¿y aun así pretenden poseer el país?
verse_text_bilingual:
Therefore tell them, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood: and shall you possess the land?

Por tanto, adviérteles que así dice el Señor y Dios: “Ustedes comen carne con sangre, adoran a sus ídolos y derraman sangre, ¿y aun así pretenden poseer el país?
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God says 'you shall not possess the land', which is a negative consequence of their actions, implying a promise of removal of blessing/provision.

verse_text_en: As I live, says the Lord Yahweh, surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the animals of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and didn't feed my sheep;
verse_text_es: El Señor y Dios afirma: Por falta de pastor mis ovejas han sido objeto del pillaje y han estado a merced de las bestias del campo. Mis pastores no se ocupan de mis ovejas; cuidan de sí mismos, pero no de mis ovejas. Tan cierto como que yo vivo, esto es así.
verse_text_bilingual:
As I live, says the Lord Yahweh, surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the animals of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and didn't feed my sheep;

El Señor y Dios afirma: Por falta de pastor mis ovejas han sido objeto del pillaje y han estado a merced de las bestias del campo. Mis pastores no se ocupan de mis ovejas; cuidan de sí mismos, pero no de mis ovejas. Tan cierto como que yo vivo, esto es así.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect and care for his people, the sheep, from predators and those who would harm them.

verse_text_en: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; and I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.
verse_text_es: Así dice el Señor y Dios: Yo estoy en contra de los pastores. Les pediré cuentas de mi rebaño; les quitaré la responsabilidad de apacentar a mis ovejas y no se apacentarán más a sí mismos. Rescataré mis ovejas de su boca, para que no les sirvan de alimento.
verse_text_bilingual:
Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; and I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.

Así dice el Señor y Dios: Yo estoy en contra de los pastores. Les pediré cuentas de mi rebaño; les quitaré la responsabilidad de apacentar a mis ovejas y no se apacentarán más a sí mismos. Rescataré mis ovejas de su boca, para que no les sirvan de alimento.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to deliver his people from the shepherds (representing evil) and protect them.

verse_text_en: For thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.
verse_text_es: »”Así dice el Señor y Dios: Yo mismo me encargaré de buscar y de cuidar a mi rebaño.
verse_text_bilingual:
For thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.

»”Así dice el Señor y Dios: Yo mismo me encargaré de buscar y de cuidar a mi rebaño.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God commits to personally seek out and protect his people.

verse_text_en: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so will I seek out my sheep; and I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
verse_text_es: Como un pastor que cuida de sus ovejas cuando están dispersas, así me ocuparé de mis ovejas y las rescataré de todos los lugares donde, en un día oscuro y de nubarrones, fueron dispersadas.
verse_text_bilingual:
As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so will I seek out my sheep; and I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

Como un pastor que cuida de sus ovejas cuando están dispersas, así me ocuparé de mis ovejas y las rescataré de todos los lugares donde, en un día oscuro y de nubarrones, fueron dispersadas.
promise_type_description: God rescues His people from bondage, danger or judgment.
why_promise: God promises to deliver his people from all places where they have been scattered.

verse_text_en: I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land; and I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
verse_text_es: Yo las sacaré de entre las naciones; las reuniré de los países y las llevaré a su tierra. Las apacentaré en los montes de Israel, en los canales de los ríos y en todos los poblados del país.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land; and I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

Yo las sacaré de entre las naciones; las reuniré de los países y las llevaré a su tierra. Las apacentaré en los montes de Israel, en los canales de los ríos y en todos los poblados del país.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God's promise to restore and provide for Israel's restoration.

verse_text_en: I will feed them with good pasture; and on the mountains of the height of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie down in a good fold; and on fat pasture shall they feed on the mountains of Israel.
verse_text_es: Las haré pastar en los mejores prados y en los montes altos de Israel estará su pastizal. Allí descansarán en un buen lugar de pastoreo y se alimentarán de los mejores pastos de los montes de Israel.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will feed them with good pasture; and on the mountains of the height of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie down in a good fold; and on fat pasture shall they feed on the mountains of Israel.

Las haré pastar en los mejores prados y en los montes altos de Israel estará su pastizal. Allí descansarán en un buen lugar de pastoreo y se alimentarán de los mejores pastos de los montes de Israel.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises to provide for and care for his people, Israel.

verse_text_en: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down, says the Lord Yahweh.
verse_text_es: Yo mismo apacentaré mi rebaño y lo llevaré a descansar, afirma el Señor y Dios.
verse_text_bilingual:
I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down, says the Lord Yahweh.

Yo mismo apacentaré mi rebaño y lo llevaré a descansar, afirma el Señor y Dios.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God commits to be the shepherd of his people, protecting and caring for them.

verse_text_en: I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but the fat and the strong I will destroy; I will feed them in justice.
verse_text_es: Buscaré a las perdidas, haré volver a las descarriadas, vendaré a las heridas y fortaleceré a las débiles, pero destruiré a la robusta y fuerte. Yo las pastorearé con justicia.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but the fat and the strong I will destroy; I will feed them in justice.

Buscaré a las perdidas, haré volver a las descarriadas, vendaré a las heridas y fortaleceré a las débiles, pero destruiré a la robusta y fuerte. Yo las pastorearé con justicia.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to seek and care for the vulnerable sheep of Israel.

verse_text_en: As for you, O my flock, thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.
verse_text_es: »”En cuanto a ti, rebaño mío, esto es lo que dice el Señor y Dios: Juzgaré entre ovejas y ovejas, y entre carneros y machos cabríos.
verse_text_bilingual:
As for you, O my flock, thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.

»”En cuanto a ti, rebaño mío, esto es lo que dice el Señor y Dios: Juzgaré entre ovejas y ovejas, y entre carneros y machos cabríos.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God promises to judge and guide his people, the flock of Israel.

verse_text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh to them: Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
verse_text_es: »”Por eso, así dice el Señor y Dios: Yo mismo voy a juzgar entre las ovejas gordas y las flacas.
verse_text_bilingual:
Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh to them: Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

»”Por eso, así dice el Señor y Dios: Yo mismo voy a juzgar entre las ovejas gordas y las flacas.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to judge and protect his people, the sheep.

verse_text_en: therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between sheep and sheep.
verse_text_es: voy a salvar a mis ovejas, y ya no les servirán de presa. Yo juzgaré entre una oveja y otra.
verse_text_bilingual:
therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between sheep and sheep.

promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to protect and judge his people, the sheep.

verse_text_en: I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.
verse_text_es: Entonces les daré un pastor, mi siervo David, que las apacentará y será su único pastor.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.

Entonces les daré un pastor, mi siervo David, que las apacentará y será su único pastor.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to establish a new covenant with Israel, with David as the shepherd.

verse_text_en: I, Yahweh, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them; I, Yahweh, have spoken it.
verse_text_es: Yo, el Señor, seré su Dios y mi siervo David será su príncipe. Yo, el Señor, lo he dicho.
verse_text_bilingual:
I, Yahweh, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them; I, Yahweh, have spoken it.

Yo, el Señor, seré su Dios y mi siervo David será su príncipe. Yo, el Señor, lo he dicho.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God establishes a covenant with David, making him a prince among his people.

verse_text_en: I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land; and they shall dwell securely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.
verse_text_es: »”Estableceré con ellos un pacto de paz: haré desaparecer del país a las bestias feroces, para que mis ovejas puedan vivir en el desierto y dormir en los bosques con seguridad.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land; and they shall dwell securely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.

»”Estableceré con ellos un pacto de paz: haré desaparecer del país a las bestias feroces, para que mis ovejas puedan vivir en el desierto y dormir en los bosques con seguridad.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to make a covenant of peace with the nations, ensuring their safety and security.

verse_text_en: I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in its season; there shall be showers of blessing.
verse_text_es: Haré de ellos y los alrededores de mi colina una fuente de bendición. Haré caer lluvias de bendición en el tiempo oportuno.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in its season; there shall be showers of blessing.

Haré de ellos y los alrededores de mi colina una fuente de bendición. Haré caer lluvias de bendición en el tiempo oportuno.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God commits to bless the land and its inhabitants.

verse_text_en: The tree of the field shall yield its fruit, and the earth shall yield its increase, and they shall be secure in their land; and they shall know that I am Yahweh, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those who made slaves of them.
verse_text_es: Los árboles del campo darán su fruto, la tierra entregará sus cosechas y ellas vivirán seguras en su propia tierra. Y, cuando yo haga pedazos su yugo y las libere de sus tiranos, entonces sabrán que yo soy el Señor.
verse_text_bilingual:
The tree of the field shall yield its fruit, and the earth shall yield its increase, and they shall be secure in their land; and they shall know that I am Yahweh, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those who made slaves of them.

Los árboles del campo darán su fruto, la tierra entregará sus cosechas y ellas vivirán seguras en su propia tierra. Y, cuando yo haga pedazos su yugo y las libere de sus tiranos, entonces sabrán que yo soy el Señor.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to deliver and protect his people from oppression.

verse_text_en: They shall no more be a prey to the nations, neither shall the animals of the earth devour them; but they shall dwell securely, and none shall make them afraid.
verse_text_es: Ya no volverán a ser presa de las naciones ni serán devoradas por las bestias de la tierra. Vivirán seguras y nadie les infundirá temor.
verse_text_bilingual:
They shall no more be a prey to the nations, neither shall the animals of the earth devour them; but they shall dwell securely, and none shall make them afraid.

Ya no volverán a ser presa de las naciones ni serán devoradas por las bestias de la tierra. Vivirán seguras y nadie les infundirá temor.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect and secure God's people from harm.

verse_text_en: I will raise up to them a plantation for renown, and they shall be no more consumed with famine in the land, neither bear the shame of the nations any more.
verse_text_es: Les daré una tierra famosa por sus cosechas. No sufrirán hambre en la tierra ni tendrán que soportar los insultos de las naciones.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will raise up to them a plantation for renown, and they shall be no more consumed with famine in the land, neither bear the shame of the nations any more.

Les daré una tierra famosa por sus cosechas. No sufrirán hambre en la tierra ni tendrán que soportar los insultos de las naciones.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises to provide for Israel's needs and restore their reputation.

verse_text_en: They shall know that I, Yahweh, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, says the Lord Yahweh.
verse_text_es: Entonces sabrán que yo, el Señor su Dios, estoy con ellos y que ellos, el pueblo de Israel, son mi pueblo. Yo, el Señor y Dios, lo afirmo.

verse_text_es: Junto a las orillas del río crecerá toda clase de árboles frutales; sus hojas no se marchitarán, y siempre tendrán frutos. Cada mes darán frutos nuevos, porque el agua que los riega sale del santuario. Sus frutos servirán de alimento y sus hojas serán medicinales».

verse_text_es: Usted veía que los pies y los dedos de la estatua eran mitad hierro y mitad barro cocido, pues será un reino dividido. Sin embargo, tendrá aún la fuerza del hierro, aunque haya visto hierro mezclado con barro.

verse_text_es: »En los días de estos reyes el Dios del cielo establecerá un reino que jamás será destruido ni entregado a otro pueblo, sino que permanecerá para siempre y hará pedazos a todos estos reinos.

verse_text_en: Because you saw that a stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it broke in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great God has made known to the king what shall happen hereafter: and the dream is certain, and its interpretation sure.

Este es el significado de la roca que fue cortada de la montaña no por manos humanas, que hizo añicos al hierro, al bronce, al barro, a la plata y al oro.
»El gran Dios ha mostrado a Su Majestad lo que tendrá lugar en el futuro. El sueño es verdadero y esta interpretación, digna de confianza».

verse_text_en: I make a decree, that in all the dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel; for he is the living God, and steadfast forever, His kingdom that which shall not be destroyed; and his dominion shall be even to the end.

He decretado que en todo lugar de mi reino la gente adore y honre al Dios de Daniel.
Porque él es el Dios vivo,
y permanece para siempre.
Su reino jamás será destruido,
y su dominio jamás tendrá fin.

why_promise: God promises to teach and guide his people through the law and his word.

verse_text_en: and he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations afar off. They will beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, neither will they learn war any more.
verse_text_es:
Dios mismo juzgará entre muchos pueblos
y administrará justicia
a naciones poderosas y lejanas.
Convertirán sus espadas en arados
y en hoces sus lanzas.
Ya no levantará su espada nación contra nación
y nunca más se adiestrarán para la guerra.

y administrará justicia

Convertirán sus espadas en arados

promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God promises to establish a future era of peace and justice, where nations will no longer go to war.

verse_text_en: But they will sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and no one will make them afraid: For the mouth of Yahweh of Armies has spoken.
verse_text_es:
Cada uno se sentará
debajo de su vid y de su higuera;
y nadie perturbará su solaz
—el Señor de los Ejércitos lo ha dicho—.

why_promise: God's promise of safety and security for his people.

verse_text_en: Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods; but we will walk in the name of Yahweh our God forever and ever.
verse_text_es:
Todos los pueblos marchan
en nombre de sus dioses,
pero nosotros marchamos en el nombre del Señor nuestro Dios,
desde ahora y para siempre.
verse_text_bilingual:

en nombre de sus dioses,
pero nosotros marchamos en el nombre del Señor nuestro Dios,
desde ahora y para siempre.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God commits to guide his people forever and ever.

verse_text_en: "In that day," says Yahweh, "I will assemble that which is lame, and I will gather that which is driven away, and that which I have afflicted;
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to gather and protect the afflicted and the marginalized.

verse_text_en: and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation: and Yahweh will reign over them on Mount Zion from then on, even forever."
verse_text_es:
Con las ovejas lastimadas formaré un remanente
y con las exiliadas, una nación poderosa.
El Señor reinará sobre ellas en el monte Sión
desde ahora y para siempre.
verse_text_bilingual:
and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation: and Yahweh will reign over them on Mount Zion from then on, even forever."

El Señor reinará sobre ellas en el monte Sión
desde ahora y para siempre.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to make a remnant of the lame and a strong nation, and to reign over them on Mount Zion forever.

verse_text_en: You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come, yes, the former dominion will come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.
verse_text_es:
Y tú, torre del rebaño,
colina fortificada de la hija de Sión:
a ti volverá tu antiguo poderío,
la soberanía de la ciudad de Jerusalén».
verse_text_bilingual:
You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come, yes, the former dominion will come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.

Y tú, torre del rebaño,
colina fortificada de la hija de Sión:
a ti volverá tu antiguo poderío,
la soberanía de la ciudad de Jerusalén».
promise_type_description: God brings His people back into a right relationship.
why_promise: God promises to restore and revive the kingdom of Jerusalem.

verse_text_en: Be in pain, and labor to bring forth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go forth out of the city, and will dwell in the field, and will come even to Babylon. There you will be rescued. There Yahweh will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.
verse_text_es:
Retuércete y puja, hija de Sión,
como mujer a punto de dar a luz,
porque ahora vas a salir de tu ciudad
y tendrás que vivir a campo abierto.
Irás a Babilonia,
pero de allí serás rescatada;
el Señor te librará
del poder de tus enemigos.
verse_text_bilingual:
Be in pain, and labor to bring forth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go forth out of the city, and will dwell in the field, and will come even to Babylon. There you will be rescued. There Yahweh will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.

Retuércete y puja, hija de Sión,
como mujer a punto de dar a luz,
porque ahora vas a salir de tu ciudad
y tendrás que vivir a campo abierto.
Irás a Babilonia,
pero de allí serás rescatada;
el Señor te librará
del poder de tus enemigos.
promise_type_description: A divine commitment that does not fit the other categories.
why_promise: God promises to rescue and redeem the people of Judah from their enemies.

verse_text_en: Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion; for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs brass; and you will beat in pieces many peoples: and I will devote their gain to Yahweh, and their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.
verse_text_es:
¡Levántate, hija de Sión!
¡Ponte a trillar!
Yo haré de hierro tus cuernos
y de bronce tus pezuñas,
para que conviertas en polvo a muchos pueblos,
y consagres al Señor sus ganancias injustas;
sus riquezas, al Señor de toda la tierra.
verse_text_bilingual:
Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion; for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs brass; and you will beat in pieces many peoples: and I will devote their gain to Yahweh, and their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.

¡Levántate, hija de Sión!
¡Ponte a trillar!
Yo haré de hierro tus cuernos
y de bronce tus pezuñas,
para que conviertas en polvo a muchos pueblos,
y consagres al Señor sus ganancias injustas;
sus riquezas, al Señor de toda la tierra.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect and empower Israel, making them a force for God's purposes.

verse_text_en: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come forth to me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth are from of old, from everlasting.
verse_text_es:
Pero tú, Belén Efrata,
pequeña entre los clanes de Judá,
de ti saldrá el que gobernará a Israel;
sus orígenes son de un pasado distante,
desde tiempos antiguos.
verse_text_bilingual:
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come forth to me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth are from of old, from everlasting.

Pero tú, Belén Efrata,
pequeña entre los clanes de Judá,
de ti saldrá el que gobernará a Israel;

desde tiempos antiguos.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God announces the coming of a future ruler from Bethlehem, indicating a specific and future fulfillment.

verse_text_en: Therefore he will abandon them until the time that she who is in labor gives birth. Then the rest of his brothers will return to the children of Israel.
verse_text_es:
Por eso Dios los entregará al enemigo
hasta que tenga su hijo la que va a ser madre
y vuelva junto al pueblo de Israel
el resto de sus hermanos.
verse_text_bilingual:

Por eso Dios los entregará al enemigo
hasta que tenga su hijo la que va a ser madre
y vuelva junto al pueblo de Israel
el resto de sus hermanos.
promise_type_description: God brings His people back into a right relationship.
why_promise: God's promise to restore Israel through the Messiah, specifically through the birth of a child.

verse_text_en: He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of Yahweh, in the majesty of the name of Yahweh his God: and they will live, for then he will be great to the ends of the earth.
verse_text_es:
Él se establecerá y los pastoreará
con el poder del Señor,
con la majestad del nombre del Señor su Dios.
Vivirán seguros, porque él dominará
hasta los confines de la tierra.
verse_text_bilingual:
He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of Yahweh, in the majesty of the name of Yahweh his God: and they will live, for then he will be great to the ends of the earth.

Él se establecerá y los pastoreará
con el poder del Señor,
con la majestad del nombre del Señor su Dios.
Vivirán seguros, porque él dominará
hasta los confines de la tierra.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God promises to guide and lead the Messiah, who will be great to the ends of the earth.

verse_text_en: He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land, and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise against him seven shepherds, and eight leaders of men.
verse_text_es:
¡Él será nuestra paz!
Si Asiria llegara a invadir nuestro país
para pisotear nuestras fortalezas,
le haremos frente con siete pastores
y aun con ocho príncipes del pueblo.
verse_text_bilingual:
He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land, and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise against him seven shepherds, and eight leaders of men.

¡Él será nuestra paz!
Si Asiria llegara a invadir nuestro país
para pisotear nuestras fortalezas,
le haremos frente con siete pastores
y aun con ocho príncipes del pueblo.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to raise up leaders to protect Israel from Assyrian invasion.

verse_text_en: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates. He will deliver us from the Assyrian, when he invades our land, and when he marches within our border.
verse_text_es:
Ellos pastorearán a Asiria con la espada
y a la tierra de Nimrod con la daga.
Si Asiria llegara a invadir nuestro país,
si llegara a cruzar nuestras fronteras,
¡él nos rescatará!
verse_text_bilingual:
They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates. He will deliver us from the Assyrian, when he invades our land, and when he marches within our border.

Ellos pastorearán a Asiria con la espada
y a la tierra de Nimrod con la daga.
Si Asiria llegara a invadir nuestro país,
si llegara a cruzar nuestras fronteras,
¡él nos rescatará!
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to deliver Israel from Assyrian invasion and rule over Assyria.

verse_text_en: The remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples, like dew from Yahweh, like showers on the grass, that don't wait for man, nor wait for the sons of men.
verse_text_es:
El remanente de Jacob será,
en medio de muchos pueblos,
como rocío que viene del Señor,
como abundante lluvia sobre la hierba,
que no depende de los hombres
ni espera nada de ellos.
verse_text_bilingual:

El remanente de Jacob será,

como rocío que viene del Señor,
como abundante lluvia sobre la hierba,
que no depende de los hombres
ni espera nada de ellos.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God's blessing and provision for Israel, described as like dew and showers.

verse_text_en: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep; who, if he goes through, treads down and tears in pieces, and there is no one to deliver.
verse_text_es:
El remanente de Jacob será,
entre las naciones,
en medio de muchos pueblos,
como un león entre los animales del bosque,
como un leoncillo entre las ovejas del rebaño,
que al pasar las pisotea y las desgarra
sin que nadie pueda rescatarlas.

verse_text_en: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand; and you shall have no soothsayers.
verse_text_es:
Pondré fin a tus hechicerías
y no tendrás más adivinos.
verse_text_bilingual:
I will destroy witchcraft from your hand; and you shall have no soothsayers.

Pondré fin a tus hechicerías
y no tendrás más adivinos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect his people from false prophets and spiritual deception.

verse_text_en: Don't rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.
verse_text_es:
Enemiga mía, no te alegres de mi mal.
Aunque haya caído me levantaré.
Aunque vivo en tinieblas
el Señor es mi luz.
verse_text_bilingual:

Aunque vivo en tinieblas
el Señor es mi luz.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to be a light in the darkness, providing comfort and hope in times of adversity.

verse_text_en: A day to build your walls-- In that day, he will extend your boundary.
verse_text_es:
El día que tus muros sean reconstruidos
será el momento de extender tus fronteras.
verse_text_bilingual:

El día que tus muros sean reconstruidos
será el momento de extender tus fronteras.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to extend Israel's boundary, implying protection and security.

verse_text_en: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.
verse_text_es:
Ese día acudirán a ti los pueblos,
desde Asiria hasta las ciudades de Egipto;
desde Egipto hasta el río Éufrates,
de mar a mar
y de montaña a montaña.
verse_text_bilingual:
In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.

Ese día acudirán a ti los pueblos,
desde Asiria hasta las ciudades de Egipto;
desde Egipto hasta el río Éufrates,
de mar a mar
y de montaña a montaña.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to protect and defend Israel from Assyria and other nations.

verse_text_en: "As in the days of your coming forth out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things."
verse_text_es:
Muéstrale tus maravillas,
como cuando lo sacaste de Egipto.

why_promise: God's future actions are described, but no direct commitment is made to a specific outcome.

verse_text_en: They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth they shall come trembling out of their dens. They will come with fear to Yahweh our God, and will be afraid because of you.
verse_text_es:
Lamerán el polvo como serpientes,
como los reptiles de la tierra.
Saldrán temblando de sus escondrijos
y, temerosos ante tu presencia,
se volverán a ti, Señor y Dios nuestro.
verse_text_bilingual:

Saldrán temblando de sus escondrijos

promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.

verse_text_en: He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot; and you will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
verse_text_es:
Vuelve a compadecerte de nosotros.
Pon tu pie sobre nuestras maldades
y arroja al fondo del mar todos nuestros pecados.
verse_text_bilingual:

y arroja al fondo del mar todos nuestros pecados.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to have compassion on his people and to cast their sins away.

verse_text_en: You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
verse_text_es:
Muestra tu fidelidad a Jacob
y tu lealtad a Abraham,
como desde tiempos antiguos
se lo juraste a nuestros antepasados.
verse_text_bilingual:
You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.

Muestra tu fidelidad a Jacob
y tu lealtad a Abraham,
como desde tiempos antiguos
se lo juraste a nuestros antepasados.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: God reiterates his sworn promises to Abraham and Jacob, demonstrating his commitment to justice and mercy.

verse_text_en: Thus says Yahweh: "Though they be in full strength, and likewise many, even so they will be cut down, and he shall pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.
verse_text_es:
Así dice el Señor:
«Aunque sean fuertes y numerosos,
serán arrancados y desaparecerán.
Aunque te he afligido,
no te afligiré más.
verse_text_bilingual:
Thus says Yahweh: "Though they be in full strength, and likewise many, even so they will be cut down, and he shall pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.

serán arrancados y desaparecerán.
Aunque te he afligido,

promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to spare his people from future affliction, despite past suffering.

verse_text_en: Now will I break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart."
verse_text_es:
Voy a quebrar el yugo que te oprime,
voy a romper tus ataduras».
verse_text_bilingual:
Now will I break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart."

Voy a quebrar el yugo que te oprime,
voy a romper tus ataduras».
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God promises to break the yoke of oppression and free the people from their bonds.

verse_text_en: "Behold, I am against you," says Yahweh of Armies, "and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard."
verse_text_es:
«Pero ahora yo vengo contra ti»,
afirma el Señor de los Ejércitos.
«Convertiré en humo tus carros de guerra
y mataré a filo de espada a tus leoncillos.
Pondré fin en el país a tus rapiñas
y no volverá a oírse la voz de tus mensajeros».
verse_text_bilingual:
"Behold, I am against you," says Yahweh of Armies, "and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard."

«Pero ahora yo vengo contra ti»,
afirma el Señor de los Ejércitos.
«Convertiré en humo tus carros de guerra
y mataré a filo de espada a tus leoncillos.
Pondré fin en el país a tus rapiñas

promise_type_description: God rescues His people from bondage, danger or judgment.
why_promise: God commits to judge and punish Nineveh, specifically promising to destroy their chariots and prey, and silence their messengers.

verse_text_en: You also will be drunken. You will be hidden. You also will seek a stronghold because of the enemy.
verse_text_es:
También tú, Nínive, te embriagarás
y se embotarán tus sentidos.
También tú, por causa del enemigo,
tendrás que buscar refugio.
verse_text_bilingual:
You also will be drunken. You will be hidden. You also will seek a stronghold because of the enemy.

y se embotarán tus sentidos.
También tú, por causa del enemigo,
tendrás que buscar refugio.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: This verse describes God's judgment on Nineveh, but the language 'you will be hidden' implies God's protection from the enemy.

verse_text_en: "Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days, which you will not believe though it is told you.
verse_text_es:
«¡Miren a las naciones!
¡Contémplenlas y quédense asombrados!
Estoy por hacer en estos días una obra,
que si se la contara, no la creerían.

Estoy por hacer en estos días una obra,
que si se la contara, no la creerían.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's actions are a promise of protection and preservation for His people.

verse_text_en: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.
verse_text_es:
»El insolente no tiene el alma recta,
pero el justo vivirá por su fe.
verse_text_bilingual:
Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.

»El insolente no tiene el alma recta,
pero el justo vivirá por su fe.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's faith is the basis for the righteous living.

verse_text_en: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of Yahweh, as the waters cover the sea.
verse_text_es:
Porque se llenará la tierra con el conocimiento de la gloria del Señor
así como las aguas cubren los mares.
verse_text_bilingual:
For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of Yahweh, as the waters cover the sea.

Porque se llenará la tierra con el conocimiento de la gloria del Señor
así como las aguas cubren los mares.
promise_type_description: God supplies what His people need to sustain them.
why_promise: God promises that the earth will be filled with the knowledge of his glory.

verse_text_en: I will sweep away man and animal. I will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble with the wicked. I will cut off man from the surface of the earth, says Yahweh.
verse_text_es:
«Arrasaré con hombres y animales,
con las aves del cielo,
con los peces del mar
y con los ídolos que hacen caer a los malvados.
»Destruiré a toda la humanidad
de sobre la faz de la tierra»,
afirma el Señor.

con las aves del cielo,
con los peces del mar
y con los ídolos que hacen caer a los malvados.

verse_text_en: All the land will be made like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up, and will dwell in her place, from Benjamin's gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel to the king's winepresses.

verse_text_es: »Esta es la plaga con la que el Señor herirá a todos los pueblos que pelearon contra Jerusalén: se les pudrirá la carne en vida, se les pudrirán los ojos en las cuencas y se les pudrirá la lengua en la boca.

verse_text_en: Whatever you will ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

Le contestó Jesús:

condition_clause: If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father

verse_text_en: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.
verse_text_es: Esta es la promesa que él nos dio: la vida eterna.

This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

Esta es la promesa que él nos dio: la vida eterna.
promise_type_description: God grants favor, abundance or prosperity to His people.
why_promise: This verse quotes Jesus' promise of eternal life to believers.

verse_text_en: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don't need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
verse_text_es: En cuanto a ustedes, la unción que de él recibieron permanece en ustedes y no necesitan que nadie les enseñe. Esa unción es verdadera —no es falsa— y les enseña todas las cosas. Permanezcan en él tal y como él les enseñó.
verse_text_bilingual:
As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don't need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

En cuanto a ustedes, la unción que de él recibieron permanece en ustedes y no necesitan que nadie les enseñe. Esa unción es verdadera —no es falsa— y les enseña todas las cosas. Permanezcan en él tal y como él les enseñó.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's anointing teaches and guides believers, ensuring they remain in Him.

verse_text_en: Beloved, now we are children of God, and it is not yet revealed what we will be. But we know that, when he is revealed, we will be like him; for we will see him just as he is.
verse_text_es: Queridos hermanos, ahora somos hijos de Dios, pero todavía no se ha manifestado lo que habremos de ser. Sabemos, sin embargo, que cuando Cristo venga seremos semejantes a él, porque lo veremos tal como él es.
verse_text_bilingual:
Beloved, now we are children of God, and it is not yet revealed what we will be. But we know that, when he is revealed, we will be like him; for we will see him just as he is.

Queridos hermanos, ahora somos hijos de Dios, pero todavía no se ha manifestado lo que habremos de ser. Sabemos, sin embargo, que cuando Cristo venga seremos semejantes a él, porque lo veremos tal como él es.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: This verse describes the future hope of believers being like God when he is revealed.

verse_text_en: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

verse_text_bilingual:
This is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's willingness to listen to human prayers, as expressed in this verse, is a promise of guidance.
condition_clause: if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us

verse_text_en: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is a sin leading to death. I don't say that he should make a request concerning this.
verse_text_es: Si alguno ve a su hermano cometer un pecado que no lleva a la muerte, ore por él y Dios le dará vida. Me refiero a quien comete un pecado que no lleva a la muerte. Hay pecado que sí lleva a la muerte y en ese caso no digo que se ore por él.
verse_text_bilingual:

promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God gives life to those who sin not leading to death, indicating guidance on discerning between sins.
condition_clause: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death

verse_text_en: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

why_promise: God's blessings and presence are assured to believers.
deity_names: God, the Father, the LORD, the Son

verse_text_en: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes I will give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.
verse_text_es: »El que tenga oídos, que oiga lo que el Espíritu dice a las iglesias. Al que salga vencedor le daré derecho a comer del árbol de la vida que está en el paraíso de Dios.

promise_type_description: God saves His people from sin and gives eternal life.
why_promise: God promises salvation and eternal life to those who overcome through faith in Jesus Christ.

verse_text_en: Don't be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.
verse_text_es: No tengas miedo de lo que estás por sufrir. Te advierto que el diablo meterá a algunos de ustedes en la cárcel para ponerlos a prueba y sufrirán aflicciones durante diez días. Sé fiel hasta la muerte y yo te daré la corona de la vida.

why_promise: God promises to protect and reward believers who remain faithful to death.

verse_text_es: »El que tenga oídos, que oiga lo que el Espíritu dice a las iglesias. Al que salga vencedor le daré del maná escondido y le daré también una piedrecita blanca en la que está escrito un nombre nuevo que solo conoce quien la recibe.

verse_text_en: He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots; as I also have received of my Father:

—así como yo la he recibido de mi Padre— y

and I will give him the morning star.

verse_text_en: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
verse_text_es: El que salga vencedor se vestirá de blanco. Jamás borraré su nombre del libro de la vida, sino que reconoceré su nombre delante de mi Padre y delante de sus ángeles.

verse_text_en: Behold, I give of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie. Behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.

verse_text_en: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.
verse_text_es: Al que salga vencedor lo haré columna del templo de mi Dios y ya no saldrá jamás de allí. Sobre él escribiré el nombre de mi Dios y el nombre de la nueva Jerusalén, ciudad de mi Dios, la que baja del cielo de parte de mi Dios; también grabaré sobre él mi nombre nuevo.

verse_text_en: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.

verse_text_en: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, "Behold, God's dwelling is with people, and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.
verse_text_es: Oí una potente voz que provenía del trono y decía: «¡Aquí, entre los seres humanos, está el santuario de Dios! Él habitará en medio de ellos y ellos serán su pueblo; Dios mismo estará con ellos y será su Dios.

promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.

verse_text_en: He will wipe away from them every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more. The first things have passed away."

why_promise: God commits to wiping away tears, removing death, mourning, crying, and pain, which is a promise of salvation and restoration.

verse_text_en: He said to me, "It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.

verse_text_en: He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.
verse_text_es: El que salga vencedor heredará todo esto y yo seré su Dios y él será mi hijo.
verse_text_bilingual:
He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.

El que salga vencedor heredará todo esto y yo seré su Dios y él será mi hijo.
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God commits to give spiritual blessings and relationship to those who overcome, describing a new covenant relationship.

verse_text_en: The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.
verse_text_es: Las naciones caminarán a la luz de la ciudad, y los reyes de la tierra le entregarán sus espléndidas riquezas.
verse_text_bilingual:
The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

Las naciones caminarán a la luz de la ciudad, y los reyes de la tierra le entregarán sus espléndidas riquezas.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God's kingdom will guide and lead the nations.

verse_text_en: Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there will be no night there),
verse_text_es: Sus puertas estarán abiertas todo el día, pues allí no habrá noche.
verse_text_bilingual:
Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there will be no night there),

Sus puertas estarán abiertas todo el día, pues allí no habrá noche.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to preserve and protect the New Jerusalem.

verse_text_en: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that they may enter.
verse_text_es: Y llevarán a ella todas las riquezas y el honor de las naciones.
verse_text_bilingual:
and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that they may enter.

Y llevarán a ella todas las riquezas y el honor de las naciones.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: God invites all nations to bring their glory and honor into the new heaven and earth.

verse_text_en: There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb's book of life.
verse_text_es: Nunca entrará en ella nada impuro, ni los idólatras ni los farsantes, sino solo aquellos que tienen su nombre escrito en el libro de la vida, el libro del Cordero.
verse_text_bilingual:
There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb's book of life.

Nunca entrará en ella nada impuro, ni los idólatras ni los farsantes, sino solo aquellos que tienen su nombre escrito en el libro de la vida, el libro del Cordero.
promise_type_description: God saves His people from sin and gives eternal life.
why_promise: God promises to save only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life.

verse_text_en: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants serve him.
verse_text_es: Ya no habrá maldición. El trono de Dios y del Cordero estará en la ciudad. Sus siervos lo adorarán;
verse_text_bilingual:
There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants serve him.

Ya no habrá maldición. El trono de Dios y del Cordero estará en la ciudad. Sus siervos lo adorarán;
promise_type_description: A binding, enduring commitment God makes to His people.
why_promise: God himself commits to abolish all curses and establish a new covenant with his people.

verse_text_en: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
verse_text_es: lo verán cara a cara y llevarán su nombre en la frente.
verse_text_bilingual:
They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

lo verán cara a cara y llevarán su nombre en la frente.
promise_type_description: God leads His people by His word, presence and counsel.
why_promise: This is a promise of God's presence and identification with believers.

verse_text_en: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.
verse_text_es: Ya no habrá noche; no necesitarán luz de lámpara ni de sol, porque el Señor Dios los alumbrará. Y reinarán por los siglos de los siglos.
verse_text_bilingual:
There will be no night, and they need no lamp light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.

Ya no habrá noche; no necesitarán luz de lámpara ni de sol, porque el Señor Dios los alumbrará. Y reinarán por los siglos de los siglos.
promise_type_description: God shields His people from harm, danger or enemies.
why_promise: God's promise to illuminate and protect his people forever.
